abraahaamu kumaarudagu daaveedu kumaarudaina yesu kreesthu vamshaavali.
abraahaamu issaakunu kanenu, issaaku yaakobunu kanenu, yaakobu yoodhaanu athani annadammulanu kanenu;
yoodhaa thaamaarunandu peresunu, jerahunu kanenu; peresu esromunu kanenu
esromu araamunu kanenu, araamu ammeenaadaabunu kanenu, ammeenaadaabu nayassonunu kanenu;
nayassonu shalmaanunu kanenu, shalmaanu raahaabunandu boyajunu kanenu, boyaju roothunandu obedunu kanenu, obedu yeshshayini kanenu;
yeshshayi raajaina daaveedunu kanenu. ooriyaa bhaaryagaanundina aameyandu daaveedu solomonunu kanenu.
solomonu rehabaamunu kanenu; rehabaamu abeeyaanu kanenu, abeeyaa aasaanu kanenu;
aasaa yehoshaapaathunu kanenu, yehoshaapaathu yehoraamunu kanenu, yehoraamu ujjiyaanu kanenu;
ujjiyaa yothaamunu kanenu,yothaamu aahaajunu kanenu, aahaaju hijkiyaanu kanenu;
hijkiyaa manashshenu kanenu, manashshe aamonunu kanenu, aamonu yosheeyaanu kanenu;
yoodulu babulonuku konipobadina kaalamulo yosheeyaa yekonyaanu athani sahodarulanu kanenu.
babulonuku konipobadina tharuvaatha yekonyaa shayalthee yelunu kanenu, shayaltheeyelu jerubbaabelunu kanenu;
jerubbaabelu abeehoodunu kanenu, abeehoodu elyaa keemunu kanenu, elyaakeemu ajorunu kanenu;
ajoru saadokunu kanenu, saadoku aakeemunu kanenu, aakeemu eleehoodunu kanenu;
eleehoodu eliyaajarunu kanenu, eliyaajaru matthaanunu kanenu, matthaanu yaako bunu kanenu;
yaakobu mariya bharthayaina yosepunu kanenu, aameyandu kreesthu anabadina yesu puttenu.

itlu abraahaamu modalukoni daaveedu varaku tharamu lanniyu padunaalugu tharamulu. daaveedu modalukoni yoodulu babulonuku konipobadina kaalamuvaraku padu naalugu tharamulu; babulonuku konipobadinadhi modalu koni kreesthu varaku padunaalugu tharamulu.
yesu kreesthu jananavidha metlanagaa, aayana thalliyaina mariya yosepunaku pradhaanamu cheyabadina tharuvaatha vaarekamu kaakamunupu aame parishuddhaatmavalana garbhavathigaa undenu.
aame bharthayaina yosepu neethimanthudaiyundi aamenu avamaanaparachanollaka rahasyamugaa aamenu vidanaada uddheshinchenu.

athadu ee sangathulanu goorchi aalochinchukonuchundagaa, idigo prabhuvu dootha svapnamandu athaniki pratyakshamai daaveedu kumaarudavaina yosepoo, nee bhaaryayaina mariyanu cherchu konutaku bhayapadakumu, aame garbhamu dharinchinadhi parishuddhaatmavalana kaliginadhi;
thana prajalanu vaari paapamulanundi aayane rakshinchunu ganuka aayanaku yesu anu peru pettuduvanenu.
idigo kanyaka garbhavathiyai kumaaruni kanunu aayanaku immaanuyelanu peru pettuduru
ani prabhuvu thana pravakthadvaaraa palikina maata neraveru natlu idanthayu jarigenu. Immaanuyelanu perunaku bhaashaantharamuna dhevudu manaku thoodani arthamu.
yosepu nidramelukoni prabhuvu dootha thanaku aagnaapinchina prakaaramuchesi, thana bhaaryanu cherchukoni
aame kumaaruni kanu varaku aamenu erugakundenu; athadu aa kumaaruniki yesu anu peru pettenu.
raajaina herodu dinamulayandu yoodaya dheshapu betlehemulo yesu puttina pimmata idigo thoorpu dheshapu gnaanulu yerooshalemunaku vachi
yoodula raajugaa puttinavaadekkada nunnaadu? thoorpudikkuna memu aayana nakshatramu chuchi, aayananu poojimpa vachithimani cheppiri
heroduraaju ee sangathi vinnappudu athadunu athanithoo kooda yerooshalemu vaarandarunu kalavarapadiri.
kaabatti raaju pradhaana yaajakulanu prajalalonundu shaastrulanu andarini samakoorchikreesthu ekkada puttunani vaarinadigenu.

anduku vaaru yoodaya betlehemulone; yelayanagaa yoodayadheshapu betlehemaa neevu yoodhaa pradhaanulalo enthamaatramunu alpamainadaanavu kaavu;ishraayelanu naa prajalanu paripaalinchu adhipathi neelonundi vachunu ani pravakthadvaaraa vraayabadiyunnadaniri.
anthata herodu aa gnaanulanu rahasyamugaa pilipinchi,
aa nakshatramu kanabadina kaalamu vaarichetha parishkaaramugaa telisikoni
meeru velli, aa shishuvu vishayamai jaagratthagaa vichaarinchi telisikonagaane, nenunu vachi,aayananu poojinchunatlu naaku varthamaanamu tendani cheppi vaarini betlehemunaku pampenu.
vaaru raaju maata vini bayaludheri povuchundagaa, idigo thoorpudheshamuna vaaru chuchina nakshatramu aa shishuvu undina chootiki meedugaa vachi niluchuvaraku vaariki mundhugaa nadichenu.
vaaru aa nakshatramunu chuchi, atyaanandabharithulai yintiloniki vachi,
thalliyaina mariyanu aa shishuvunu chuchi, saagilapadi, aayananu poojinchi, thama pettelu vippi, bangaaramunu saambraanini bolamunu kaanukalugaa aayanaku samarpinchiri.
tharuvaatha herodunoddhaku vellavaddani svapnamandu dhevunichetha bodhimpabadinavaarai vaaru mariyoka maargamuna thama dheshamunaku thirigi velliri.

vaaru vellina tharuvaatha idigo prabhuvu dootha svapna mandu yosepunaku pratyakshamai herodu aa shishuvunu sanharimpavalenani aayananu vedakabovuchunnaadu ganuka neevu lechi aa shishuvunu aayana thallini ventabettukoni aigupthunaku paaripoyi, nenu neethoo teliyajeppuvaraku akkadane yundumani athanithoo cheppenu.
appudathadu lechi, raatrivela shishuvunu thallini thoodukoni,
aigupthunaku velli aigupthulonundi naa kumaaruni pilichithini ani pravakthadvaaraa prabhuvu selavichina maata neravercha badunatlu herodu maranamuvaraku akkadanundenu.

aa gnaanulu thannu apahasinchirani herodu grahinchi bahu aagrahamu techukoni, thaanu gnaanulavalana vivara mugaa telisikonina kaalamunubatti, betlehemulonu daani sakala praanthamulalonu, rendu samvatsaramulu modalukoni thakkuva vayassugala magapillala nandarini vadhinchenu.
anduvalana raamaalo angalaarpu vinabadenu edpunu mahaarodhanadhvaniyu kaligenu
raahelu thana pillalavishayamai yedchuchu vaaru lenanduna odaarpu pondanollaka yundenu ani pravakthayaina yirmeeyaadvaaraa cheppabadina vaakyamu neraverenu.
herodu chanipoyina tharuvaatha idigo prabhuvu dootha aigupthulo yosepunaku svapnamandu pratyakshamai
neevu lechi, shishuvunu thallini thoodukoni, ishraayelu dheshamunaku vellumu;
shishuvu praanamu theeyajoochu chundinavaaru chanipoyirani cheppenu. Appudathadu lechi, shishuvunu thallini thoodukoni ishraayelu dheshamunaku vacchenu.
ayithe arkelaayu thana thandriyaina herodunaku prathigaa yoodayadheshamu

eluchunnaadani vini, akkadiki vella verachi, svapnamandu dhevunichetha bodhimpabadinavaadai galilaya praanthamulaku velli, najarethanu ooriki vachi akkada kaapuramundenu. aayana najareyudanabadunani pravakthalu cheppinamaata neraverunatlu (eelaagu jarigenu.)
aa dinamulayandu baapthismamichu yohaanu vachi
paralokaraajyamu sameepinchiyunnadhi, maarumanassu pondudani yoodaya aranyamulo prakatinchuchundenu.
prabhuvu maargamu siddhaparachudi aayana trovalu saraalamu cheyudani aranyamulo kekaveyu nokani shabdamu ani pravakthayaina yeshayaa dvaaraa cheppabadinavaadithade.
ee yohaanu onte romamula vastramunu, molachuttu thooludattiyu dharinchukonuvaadu; midathalunu adavi theneyu athaniki aahaaramu.
aa samayamuna yerooshalemu vaarunu yoodaya vaarandarunu yordaanu nadeepraanthamula vaarandarunu, athaniyoddhaku vachi,
thama paapamulu oppukonuchu, yordaanu nadhilo athanichetha baapthismamu ponduchundiri.

athadu parisayyulalonu, saddookayyulalonu, anekulu baapthismamu pondavachuta chuchi sarpasanthaanamaa, raabovu ugrathanu thappinchukonutaku meeku buddhi cheppinavaadevadu? Maarumanassuku thagina phalamu phalinchudi.
abraahaamu maaku thandri ani meelo meeru cheppukona thalancha vaddu;
dhevudu ee raallavalana abraahaamunaku pillalanu puttimpagaladani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
ippude goddali chetlaveruna unchabadiyunnadhi ganuka manchi phalamu phaliṁ pani prathi chettunu narakabadi agnilo veyabadunu.

maarumanassu nimitthamu nenu neellalo meeku baapthisma michuchunnaanu; ayithe naa venuka vachuchunnavaadu naakante shakthimanthudu; aayana cheppulu moyutakainanu nenu paatrudanu kaanu; aayana parishuddhaatmalonu agni thoonu meeku baapthismamichunu.
aayana cheta aayana chethilo unnadhi; aayana thana kallamunu baagugaa shubhramu chesi godhumalanu kottuloposi, aarani agnithoo pottunu kaalchiveyunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
aa samayamuna yohaanuchetha baapthismamu pondutaku yesu galilayanundi yordaanu daggara nunna athaniyoddhaku vacchenu.
anduku yohaanu nenu neechetha baapthismamu pondavalasinavaadanai yundagaa neevu naayoddhaku vachu chunnaavaa? Ani aayananu nivaarimpajoochenu gaani
yesu'ippatiki kaanimmu; neethi yaavatthu eelaagu nera verchuta manaku thagiyunnadani athaniki uttharamicchenu ganuka athadaalaagu kaanicchenu.
yesu baapthismamu pondina ventane neellalonundi oddunaku vacchenu; idigo aakaashamu teravabadenu, dhevuni aatma paavuramuvale digi thanameediki vachuta chuchenu.
mariyu idigo eeyane naa priya kumaarudu, eeyana yandu nenaanandinchu chunnaanani yoka shabdamu aakaashamunundi vacchenu.
appudu yesu apavaadhichetha shodhimpabadutaku aatma valana aranyamunaku konipobadenu.
naluvadhi dinamulu naluvadhiraatrulu upavaasamundina pimmata aayana aakaligonagaa
aa shodhakudu aayanayoddhaku vachineevu dhevuni kumaarudavaithe ee raallu rottelagunatlu aagnaapinchu manenu
andukaayana manushyudu rottevalana maatramu kaadugaani dhevuni notanundi vachu prathimaatavalananu jeevinchunu ani vraayabadiyunnadanenu.
anthata apavaadhi parishuddha pattanamunaku aayananu theesikonipoyi, dhevaalaya shikharamuna aayananu niluvabetti
neevu dhevuni kumaarudavaithe krindiki dumukumu aayana ninnu goorchi thana doothala kaagnaapinchunu,nee paadameppudainanu raathiki thagulakunda vaaru ninnu chethulathoo etthikonduru
ani vraayabadiyunnadani aayanathoo cheppenu.Anduku yesuprabhuvaina nee dhevuni neevu shodhimpavaladani mariyoka choota vraayabadiyunnadani vaanithoo cheppenu.
marala apavaadhi migula etthayina yoka kondameediki aayananu thoodukonipoyi, yee loka raajyamulannitini, vaati mahimanu aayanaku choopi
neevu saagilapadi naaku namaskaaramu chesinayedala veetinannitini neekiccheda nani aayanathoo cheppagaa
yesu vaanithoo-saathaanaa, pommu-prabhuvaina nee dhevuniki mrokki aayananu maatramu sevimpavalenu ani vraayabadiyunnadanenu.
anthata apavaadhi aayananu vidichipogaa, idigo dhevadoothalu vachi aayanaku paricharya chesiri.
yohaanu cherapattabadenani yesu vini galilayaku thirigi velli
najarethu vidichi jebooloonu naphthaaliyanu dheshamula praanthamulalo samudratheeramandali kapernahoomunaku vachi kaapuramundenu.
jebooloonu dheshamunu, naphthaalidheshamunu, yordaanuku aavalanunna samudratheeramuna anyajanulu nivasinchu galilayayu
chikatilo koorchundiyunna prajalunu goppa velugu chuchiri. Marana pradheshamulonu maranacchaayalonu koorchundiyunna vaariki velugu udayinchenu
ani pravakthayaina yeshayaadvaaraa palukabadinadhi neraveru natlu (eelaagu jarigenu.)
appati nundi yesu paraloka raajyamu sameepinchiyunnadhi ganuka maarumanassu pondudani cheppuchu prakatimpa modalu pettenu.
yesu galilaya samudratheeramuna naduchuchundagaa, pethuranabadina seemonu athani sahodarudaina andreya anu iddaru sahodarulu samudramulo valaveyuta chuchenu; vaaru jaalarulu.
aayananaa vembadi randi, nenu mimmunu manushyulanu pattujaalarulanugaa chethunani vaarithoo cheppenu;
ventane vaaru thama valalu vidichipetti aayananu vembadinchiri.

aayana akkadanundi velli jebedayi kumaarudaina yaakobu, athani sahodarudaina yohaanu anu mari yiddaru sahodarulu thama thandri yaina jebedayi yoddha donelo thama valalu baaguchesi konuchundagaa chuchi vaarini pilichenu.
ventane vaaru thama donenu thama thandrini vidichipetti aayananu vembadinchiri.
yesu vaari samaajamandiramulalo bodhinchuchu, (dhevuni) raajyamunu goorchina suvaarthanu prakatinchuchu, prajalaloni prathi vyaadhini, rogamunu svasthaparachuchu galilayayandanthata sancharinchenu.

aayana keerthi siriya dheshamanthata vyaapinchenu. Naanaavidhamulaina rogamula chethanu vedhanalachethanu peedimpabadina vyaadhi grasthulanandarini, dayyamupattinavaarini, chaandrarogulanu, pakshavaayuvu galavaarini vaaru aayanayoddhaku theesikoni raagaa aayana vaarini svasthaparachenu.
galilaya, dekapoli, yerooshalemu, yoodayayanu pradheshamulanundiyu yordaanu naku avathalanundiyu bahu janasamoohamulu aayananu vembadinchenu.
aayana aa janasamoohamulanu chuchi kondayekki koorchundagaa aayana shishyulaayanayoddhaku vachiri.
appudaayana noru terachi yeelaagu bodhimpasaagenu
aatmavishayamai deenulainavaaru dhanyulu; paralokaraajyamu vaaridi.
duḥkhapaduvaaru dhanyulu; vaaru odaarchabaduduru.
saatvikulu dhanyulu; vaaru bhoolokamunu svathantrinchukonduru.
neethikoraku aakalidappulu galavaaru dhanyulu; vaarutrupthiparachabaduduru.
kanikaramugalavaaru dhanyulu; vaaru kanikaramu ponduduru.
hrudayashuddhigalavaaru dhanyulu; vaaru dhevuni chuchedaru.
samaadhaanaparachuvaaru dhanyulu; vaaru dhevuni kumaarulanabaduduru.
neethi nimitthamu hinsimpabaduvaaru dhanyulu; paraloka raajyamu vaaridi.
naa nimitthamu janulu mimmunu nindinchi hinsinchi meemeeda abaddhamugaa cheddamaatalella palukunappudu meeru dhanyulu.
santhooshinchi aanandinchudi, paralokamandu mee phalamu adhikamagunu. eelaaguna vaaru meeku poorvamandundina pravakthalanu himsinchiri.
meeru lokamunaku uppayi yunnaaru. Uppu nissaaramaithe adhi dhenivalana saaramu pondunu? adhi bayata paaraveyabadi manushyulachetha trokkabadutake gaani mari dhenikini panikiraadu.
meeru lokamunaku velugaiyunnaaru; kondameedanundu pattanamu marugaiyundaneradu.
manushyulu deepamu veliginchi kunchamu krinda pettaru kaani adhi yintanundu vaarikandariki velugichutakai deepasthambhamumeedane pettuduru.
manushyulu mee satkriyalanu chuchi paralokamandunna mee thandrini mahimaparachunatlu vaariyeduta mee velugu prakaashimpa niyyudi.
dharmashaastramunainanu pravakthala vachanamulanainanu kotti veyavachithinani thalanchavaddu; neraverchutake gaani kotti veyutaku nenu raaledu.
aakaashamunu bhoomiyu gathinchipoyinane gaani dharmashaastramanthayu neraveruvaraku daaninundi yoka pollayinanu oka sunnayainanu thappi podani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.

kaabatti yee yaagnalalo migula alpamaina yokadaaninainanu meeri, manushyulaku aalaaguna cheya bodhinchuvaadevado vaadu paralokaraajyamulo migula alpudanabadunu; ayithe vaatini gaikoni bodhinchuvaadevado vaadu paraloka raajyamulo goppavaadanabadunu.
shaastrula neethi kantenu parisayyula neethikantenu mee neethi adhikamu kaaniyedala meeru paralokaraajyamulo praveshimpanerarani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
narahatya cheyavaddu; narahatya cheyuvaadu vimarshaku lonagunani poorvikulathoo cheppabadina maata meeru vinnaaru gadaa.

nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa thana sahodarunimeeda kopapadu prathivaadu vimarshaku lonagunu, thana sahodaruni chuchi vyarthudaa ani cheppu vaadu mahaasabhaku lonagunu; drohee ani cheppuvaadu narakaagniki lonagunu.
kaavuna neevu balipeethamunoddha arpanamu narpinchuchundagaa neemeeda nee sahodaruniki virodha memainanukaladani akkada neeku gnaapakamu vachinayedala
akkada balipeethamu nedutane nee yarpanamu vidichipetti, modata velli nee sahodarunithoo samaadhaanapadumu; atu tharuvaatha vachi nee yarpanamu narpimpumu.

nee prathi vaadhithoo neevunu trovalo undagaane tvaragaa vaanithoo samaadhaanapadumu; leniyedala okavela nee prathivaadhi ninnu nyaayaadhipathiki appaginchunu, nyaayaadhipathi ninnu bantrauthuku appaginchunu, anthata neevu cherasaalalo veyabaduduvu.
kadapati kaasu chellinchuvaraku akkada nundi neevu velupaliki raaneravani neethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
vyabhichaaramu cheyavaddani cheppabadina maata meeru vinnaarugadaa;
nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa oka streeni mohapuchooputhoo choochu prathivaadu appude thana hrudayamandu aamethoo vyabhichaaramu chesinavaadagunu.

nee kudikannu ninnu abhyanthara parachinayedala daani periki neeyoddhanundi paaraveyumu; nee dheha manthayu narakamulo padaveyabadakunda nee avayavamu lalo nokati nashinchuta neeku prayojanakaramugadaa.
nee kudicheyyi ninnabhyanthara parachinayedala daani nariki neeyoddhanundi paaraveyumu; nee dhehamanthayu naraka mulo padakunda nee avayavamulalo okati nashinchuta neeku prayojanakaramu gadaa.
thana bhaaryanu vidanaadu vaadu aameku parityaaga patrika yiyyavalenani cheppa badiyunnadhi gadaa;

nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa vyabhichaarakaaranamunubatti gaaka, thana bhaaryanu vidanaadu prathivaadunu aamenu vyabhichaarinigaa cheyuchunnaadu; vidanaadabadinadaanini pendlaaduvaadu vyabhicharinchuchunnaadu.
mariyu neevu apramaanamu cheyaka nee pramaanamulanu prabhuvunaku chellimpavalenani poorvikulathoo cheppabadina maata meeru vinnaaru gadaa,
nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa enthamaatramu ottupettukonavaddu; aakaashamu thoodana vaddu; adhi dhevuni sinhaasanamu,bhoomi thoodana vaddu,
adhi aayana paadapeethamu, yerooshalemuthoodana vaddu; adhi mahaaraaju pattanamu
nee thala thoodani ottupettukonavaddu, neevu oka vendrukanainanu telupugaa gaani nalupugaa gaani cheyalevu.
mee maata avunante avunu, kaadante kaadu ani yundavalenu; veetiki minchunadhi dushtuninundi puttunadhi.
kantiki kannu, pantiki pallu ani cheppabadina maata meeru vinnaaru gadaa.
nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa dushtuni edirimpaka, ninnu kudichempameeda kottuvaani vaipunaku edamachempakooda trippumu.
evadaina neemeeda vyaajyemu vesi nee angee theesikonagorina yedala vaaniki nee paivastramukooda ichiveyumu.
okadu oka mailu dooramu rammani ninnu balavanthamu chesinayedala, vaanithoo kooda rendu maillu vellumu.
ninnu aduguvaanikimmu, ninnu appu aduga goruvaaninundi nee mukhamu trippu konavaddu.
nee poruguvaani preminchi, nee shatruvunu dveshinchumani cheppabadina maata meeru vinnaaru gadaa;
nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa, meeru paralokamandunna mee thandriki kumaarulai yundunatlu mee shatruvulanu preminchudi. Mimmunu hinsinchu vaarikoraku praarthana cheyudi.
aayana cheddavaarimeedanu manchivaarimeedanu thana sooryuni udayimpajesi, neethimanthulameedanu, aneethi manthulameedanu varshamu kuripinchuchunnaadu.
meeru mimmunu preminchuvaarine preminchinayedala meekemi phalamu kalugunu? Sunkarulunu aalaagu cheyuchunnaaru gadaa.
mee sahodarulaku maatramu vandhanamu chesina yedala meeru ekkuva cheyuchunnadhemi? Anyajanulunu aalaagu cheyuchunnaaru gadaa.
mee paralokapu thandri paripoornudu ganuka meerunu paripoornulugaa undedaru.
manushyulaku kanabadavalenani vaariyeduta mee neethi kaaryamu cheyakunda jaagratthapadudi; leniyedala paralokamandunna mee thandriyoddha meeru phalamu pondaru.

kaavuna neevu dharmamu cheyunappudu, manushyulavalana ghanatha nondavalenani, veshadhaarulu samaajamandiramula lonu veedhulalonu cheyulaaguna nee mundhara boora oodimpa vaddu; vaaru thama phalamu pondiyunnaarani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
neevaithe dharmamu cheyunappudu, nee dharmamu rahasyamugaanundu nimitthamu nee kudicheyyi cheyunadhi nee yedamachethiki teliyakayundavalenu.
atlayithe rahasyamandu choochu nee thandri neeku prathi phalamichunu

mariyu meeru praarthanacheyunappudu veshadhaarula vale undavaddhu; manushyulaku kanabadavalenani samaaja mandiramulalonu veedhula moolalalonu nilichi praarthana cheyuta vaarikishtamu; vaaru thama phalamu pondi yunnaarani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
neevu praarthana cheyunappudu, nee gadhiloniki velli thalupuvesi, rahasyamandunna nee thandriki praarthanacheyumu; appudu rahasyamandu choochu nee thandri neeku prathi phalamichunu.
mariyu meeru praarthana cheyunappudu anyajanulavale vyarthamaina maatalu vachimpavaddu; vistharinchi maatalaaduta valana thama manavi vinabadunani vaaru thalanchuchunnaaru;
meeru vaarivale undakudi. meeru mee thandrini adugaka munupe meeku akkaragaa nunnavevo aayanaku teliyunu
kaabatti meereelaagu praarthanacheyudi, paralokamandunna maa thandree, nee naamamu parishuddhaparachabadu gaaka,
nee raajyamu vachugaaka, nee chitthamu paralokamandu neraveruchunnatlu bhoomiyandunu neraverunu gaaka,
maa anudinaahaaramu nedu maaku dayacheyumu.
maa runasthulanu memu kshaminchiyunna prakaaramu maa runamulu kshaminchumu.
mammunu shodhanaloki theka dushtuninundi mammunu thappinchumu.
manushyula aparaadhamulanu meeru kshaminchinayedala, mee paralokapu thandriyu mee aparaadhamulanu kshaminchunu
meeru manushyula aparaadhamulanu kshamimpaka poyinayedala mee thandriyu mee aparaadhamulanu kshamimpadu.

meeru upavaasamu cheyunappudu veshadhaarulavale duḥkhamukhulai yundakudi; thaamu upavaasamu cheyu chunnattu manushyulaku kanabadavalenani vaaru thama mukhamu lanu vikaaramu chesikonduru; vaaru thama phalamu pondi yunnaarani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
upavaasamu cheyuchunnattu manushyulaku kanabadavalenani kaaka, rahasyamandunna nee thandrike kanabadavalenani, neevu upavaasamu cheyunappudu nee thala antukoni, nee mukhamu kadugukonumu.
appudu rahasyamandu choochuchunna nee thandri neeku prathiphalamichunu.
bhoomimeeda meekoraku dhanamunu koorchukonavaddu; ikkada chimmetayu, thuppunu thiniveyunu, dongalu kannamuvesi dongiledaru.
paralokamandu meekoraku dhanamunu koorchukonudi; acchata chimmetayainanu, thuppai nanu daani thiniveyadu, dongalu kannamuvesi dongilaru.
nee dhanamekkada nunduno akkadane nee hrudayamu undunu.
dhehamunaku deepamu kanne ganuka nee kannu thetagaa undinayedala nee dhehamanthayu velugu mayamaiyundunu.
nee kannu chedinadaithe nee dhehamanthayu chikatimayamai yundunu; neelonunna velugu chikatiyai yundina yedala aa chikati yenthoo goppadhi.

evadunu iddaru yajamaanulaku daasudugaa nundaneradu; athadu okani dveshinchiyokani preminchunu; ledaa yokani paksha mugaanundi yokani truneekarinchunu. meeru dhevunikini sirikini daasulugaa nundaneraru.
anduvalana nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa emi thindumo yemi traagudumo ani mee praanamunu goorchiyainanu, emi dharinchukondumo ani mee dhehamunu goorchiyainanu chinthimpakudi;
aakaashapakshulanu choodudi; avi vitthavu koyavu kotlalo koorchukonavu; ayinanu mee paralokapu thandri vaatini poshinchu chunnaadu; meeru vaatikante bahu shreshtulu kaaraa?
meelo nevadu chinthinchutavalana thana yetthu mooredekkuva chesikonagaladu?
vastramulanu goorchi meeru chinthimpa nela? Adavipuvvulu elaagu neduguchunnavo aalo chinchudi. Avi kashtapadavu, odakavu
ayinanu thana samastha vaibhavamuthoo koodina solomonu sahithamu veetilo nokadaanivalenainanu alankarimpabadaledu.
nedundi repu poyilo veyabadu adavi gaddini dhevudeelaagu alanka rinchinayedala, alpavishvaasulaaraa, meeku mari nishchaya mugaa vastramulu dharimpajeyunu gadaa.
kaabatti emi thindumo yemi traagudumo yemi dharinchu kondumo ani chinthimpakudi; anyajanulu veetanniti vishayamai vichaarinthuru.
ivanniyu meeku kaavalenani mee paralokapu thandriki teliyunu.
kaabatti meeru aayana raajyamunu neethini modata vedakudi; appudavanniyu meekanugrahimpabadunu.
repatinigoorchi chinthimpakudi; repati dinamu daani sangathulanugoorchi chinthinchunu; enaatikeedu aanaatiki chaalunu.
meeru theerpu theerchakudi, appudu mimmunugoorchi theerpu theerchabadadu.
meeru theerchu theerpu choppunane mimmunu goorchiyu theerpu theerchabadunu, meeru koluchukolatha choppunane meekunu koluvabadunu.
nee kantilonunna doolamu nenchaka nee sahodaruni kantilonunna nalusunu choochuta yela?
nee kantilo doolamundagaa, neevu nee sahodaruni chuchineekantilo nunna nalusunu theesi veyanimmani cheppanela?
veshadhaaree, modata nee kantilo nunna doolamunu theesivesikonumu, appudu nee sahodaruni kantilonunna nalusunu theesiveyutaku neeku thetagaa kana badunu.
parishuddhamainadhi kukkalaku pettakudi, mee mutyamulanu pandulayeduta veyakudi; vesinayedala avi yokavela vaatini kaallathoo trokki meemeeda padi mimmunu chilchi veyunu.
adugudi meekiyyabadunu. Vedakudi meeku dorakunu,thattudi meeku theeyabadunu.
adugu prathivaadunu pondunu, vedakuvaaniki dorakunu, thattuvaaniki theeya badunu.
meelo e manushyudainanu thana kumaarudu thannu rottenu adiginayedala vaaniki raathinichunaa?chepanu adiginayedala paamunichunaa?
meeru chedda vaarai yundiyu mee pillalaku manchi yeevula niyya nerigi yundagaa
paralokamandunna mee thandri thannu aduguvaariki anthakante enthoo nishchayamugaa manchi yeevula nichunu.
kaavuna manushyulu meeku emi cheyavalenani meeru koruduro aalaagunane meerunu vaariki cheyudi. Idi dharmashaastramunu pravakthala upa dheshamu naiyunnadhi.
iruku dvaaramuna praveshinchudi; naashanamunaku povu dvaaramu vedalpunu, aa daari vishaalamunaiyunnadhi, daani dvaaraa praveshinchuvaaru anekulu.
jeevamunaku povu dvaaramu irukunu aa daari sankuchithamunai yunnadhi, daani kanugonuvaaru kondare.
abaddha pravakthalanugoorchi jaagratthapadudi. Vaaru gorrela charmamulu vesikoni meeyoddhaku vatthuru kaani lopala vaaru krooramaina thoodellu.
vaari phalamulavalana meeru vaarini telisikonduru. Mundlapodalalo draaksha pandlanainanu, palleruchetlanu anjoorapu pandlanainanu koyuduraa?
aalaagunane prathi manchi chettu manchi phalamulu phalinchunu, panikimaalina chettu, kaaniphalamulu phalinchunu.
manchi chettu kaaniphalamulu phalimpaneradu, panikimaalina chettu manchi phalamulu phalimpaneradu.
manchi phalamulu phalimpani prathichettu narakabadi agnilo veyabadunu.
kaabatti meeru vaari phalamulavalana vaarini telisikonduru.
prabhuvaa, prabhuvaa, ani nannu piluchu prathivaadunu paralokaraajyamulo praveshimpadugaani paralokamandunna naa thandri chitthaprakaaramu cheyuvaade praveshinchunu.

aa dinamandu anekulu nannu chuchiprabhuvaa, prabhuvaa, memu nee naamamuna pravachimpaledaa? nee naamamuna dayyamulanu vellagottaledaa? nee naamamuna anekamaina adbhuthamulu cheyaledaa? Ani cheppuduru.
appudu nenu mimmunu ennadunu eruganu, akramamu cheyuvaaralaaraa, naayoddhanundi pondani vaarithoo cheppudunu.
kaabatti yee naa maatalu vini vaatichoppuna cheyu prathivaadunu bandameeda thana yillu kattukonina buddhimanthuni poliyundunu.
vaana kurisenu, varadalu vacchenu, gaali visiri aa yintimeeda kottenu gaani daani punaadhi bandameeda veyabadenu ganuka adhi padaledu.
mariyu yee naa maatalu vini vaatichoppuna cheyani prathivaadu isukameeda thana yillu kattukonina buddhiheenuni poliyundunu.
vaana kurisenu, varadalu vacchenu,gaali visiri aa yintimeeda kottenu, appudadhi koola badenu; daani paatu goppadani cheppenu.
yesu ee maatalu cheppi muginchinappudu janasamoohamulu aayana bodhaku aashcharyapaduchundiri.
yelayanagaa aayana vaari shaastrulavale kaaka adhikaaramugalavaanivale vaariki bodhinchenu.
aayana aa kondameedanundi digi vachinappudu bahu janasamoohamulu aayananu vembadinchenu.
idigo kushtharogi vachi aayanaku mrokkiprabhuvaa, neekishtamaithe nannu shuddhunigaa cheyagalavanenu.
andukaayana cheyyi chaapi vaani mutti naakishtame, neevu shuddhudavu kammani cheppagaa thakshaname vaani kushtarogamu shuddhi yaayenu.
appudu yesu evarithoonu emiyu cheppaku sumee; kaani neevu velli vaariki saakshyaarthamai nee dhehamunu yaajakuniki kanabarachukoni, moshe niyaminchina kaanuka samarpinchumani vaanithoo cheppenu
aayana kapernahoomulo praveshinchinappudu oka shathaadhipathi aayanayoddhaku vachi
prabhuvaa, naa daasudu pakshavaayuvuthoo migula baadhapaduchu intilo padiyunnaadani cheppi, aayananu vedukonenu.
yesu nenu vachi vaani svasthaparachedhanani athanithoo cheppagaa
aa shathaadhipathiprabhuvaa, neevu naa yintiloniki vachutaku nenu paatrudanu kaanu; neevu maatamaatramu selavimmu, appudu naa daasudu svasthaparachabadunu.
nenu kooda adhikaaramunaku lobadinavaadanu; naa chethikrinda sainikulunnaaru; nenu okani pommante povunu, okani rammante vachunu, naa daasuni ee pani cheyumante cheyunu ani yuttharamicchenu.
yesu ee maata vini aashcharyapadi, venta vachuchunnavaarini chuchi ishraayelulo nevanikainanu nenintha vishvaasamunnattu chooda ledani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
anekulu thoorpunundiyu padamatanundiyu vachi abraahaamuthoo koodanu, issaakuthoo koodanu, yaakobuthoo koodanu, paralokaraajyamandu koorchunduru gaani
raajya sambandhulu velupati chikatiloniki troyabaduduru; akkada edpunu pandlu korukutayu nundunani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
anthata yesu'ika vellumu; neevu vishvasinchina prakaaramu neeku avunugaakani shathaadhipathithoo cheppenu. aa gadiyalone athanidaasudu svasthathanondhenu.
tharuvaatha yesu pethurintilo praveshinchi, jvaramuthoo padiyunna athani atthanu chuchi
aame cheyyimuttagaa jvaramaamenu vidichenu; anthata aame lechi aayanaku upachaaramu cheyasaagenu.
saayankaalamainappudu janulu dayyamulu pattina anekulanu aayanayoddhaku theesikoni vachiri.

aayana maatavalana dayyamulanu vella gotti rogulanellanu svasthaparachenu. Anduvalana aayane mana balaheenathalanu vahinchukoni mana rogamulanu bharinchenani pravakthayaina yeshayaadvaara cheppabadinadhi neraverenu.
yesu thana yoddhanunna janasamoohamunu chuchi addariki vellavalenani aagnaapinchenu.
anthata oka shaastri vachibodhakudaa nee vekkadiki vellinanu nee ventavaccheda nani aayanathoo cheppenu.
anduku yesunakkalaku boriyalunu aakaashapakshulaku nivaasamulunu kalavu gaani manushyakumaaruniki thalavaalchukonutakainanu sthalamuledani athanithoo cheppenu.
shishyulalo mariyokadu prabhuvaa, nenu modata velli, naa thandrini paathipettutaku naaku selavimmani aayananu adugagaa
yesu athani chuchinannu vembadinchumu; mruthulu thama mruthulanu paathi pettukonanimmani cheppenu.
aayana done yekkinappudu aayana shishyulu aayana venta velliri.
anthata samudramumeeda thupaanu lechi nanduna aa done alalachetha kappabadenu. Appudaayana nidrinchuchundagaa
vaaru aayana yoddhaku vachi prabhuvaa, nashinchipovuchunnaamu, mammunu rakshinchumani cheppi aayananu lepiri.
andukaayana alpavishvaasulaaraa, yenduku bhayapaduchunnaarani vaarithoo cheppi, lechi gaalini samudramunu gaddimpagaa mikkili nimmala maayenu.
aa manushyulu aashcharyapadi eeyana etti vaado; eeyanaku gaaliyu samudramunu lobaduchunnavani cheppukoniri.

aayana addarinunna gadareneeyula dheshamu cheragaa dayyamulu pattina yiddaru manushyulu samaadhulalo nundi bayaludheri aayanaku edurugaa vachiri. Vaaru migula ugrulainanduna evadunu aa maargamuna vellaleka poyenu.
vaaru idigo dhevuni kumaarudaa, neethoo maakemi? Kaalamu raakamunupe mammunu baadhinchutaku ikkadiki vachithivaa? Ani kekaluvesiri.
vaariki dooramuna goppa pandula manda meyuchundagaa
aa dayyamulu neevu mammunu vella gottinayedala aa pandula mandaloniki ponimmani aayananu vedukonenu.
aayana vaatini pommanagaa avi aa manushyulanu vadalipetti aa pandula loniki poyenu; idigo aa mandanthayu prapaathamu nundi samudramuloniki vadigaa parugetthikonipoyi neellalo padichacchenu.
vaatini mepuchunnavaaru paaripoyi pattanamuloniki velli jarigina kaaryamulanniyu dayyamulu pattinavaari sangathiyu telipiri.
idigo aa pattanasthulandaru yesunu edurkonavachi aayananu chuchi thama praanthamulanu vidichi pommani aayananu vedukoniri.
tharuvaatha aayana done yekki samudramu daati thana pattanamulo praveshimpagaa

idigo janulu paksha vaayuvuthoo manchamupattiyunna yokani aayana yoddhaku theesikonivachiri. Yesu vaari vishvaasamuchuchi kumaarudaa dhairyamugaa undumu, nee paapamulu kshamimpabadiyunnavani pakshavaayuvu gala vaanithoo cheppenu.
idigo shaastrulalo kondaru ithadu dheva dooshana cheyuchunnaadani thamalothaamu anukonagaa
yesu vaari thalampulu grahinchi meerenduku mee hrudayamulalo duraalochanalu cheyuchunnaaru?
nee paapamulu kshamimpabadiyunnavani chepputa sulabhamaa, lechi naduvumani chepputa sulabhamaa?

ayinanu paapamulu kshaminchutaku bhoomimeeda manushyakumaaruniki adhikaaramu kaladani meeru telisikonavalenu ani cheppi, aayana pakshavaayuvugalavaani chuchineevu lechi nee mancha metthikoni nee yintiki pommani cheppagaa
vaadu lechi thana yintiki vellenu.
janulu adhi chuchi bhayapadi, manushyulakitti adhikaaramichina dhevuni mahimaparachiri.
yesu akkadanundi velluchu sunkapu mettunoddha koorchundiyunna matthayi anu oka manushyuni chuchinannu vembadinchumani athanithoo cheppagaa athadu lechi aayananu vembadinchenu.
intilo bhojanamunaku yesu koorchundiyundagaa idigo sunkarulunu paapulunu anekulu vachi aayanayoddhanu aayana shishyulayoddhanu koorchundiri.
parisayyulu adhi chuchi mee bodhakudu sunkarulathoonu paapulathoonu kalisi yenduku bhojanamu cheyuchunnaadani aayana shishyulanadigiri.
aayana aa maatavini rogulakegaani aarogyamu galavaariki vaidyudakkaraledu gadaa.
ayithe nenu paapulanu piluva vachithini gaani neethimanthulanu piluva raaledu. Ganuka kanikaramune koruchunnaanu gaani balini koranu anu vaakya bhaavamemito meeru velli nerchukonudani cheppenu.
appudu yohaanu shishyulu aayanayoddhaku vachiparisayyulunu, memunu tharachugaa upavaasamu cheyu chunnaamu gaani nee shishyulu upavaasamu cheyaru; deeniki hethuvemani aayananu adugagaa
yesupendli kumaarudu thamathookooda nundu kaalamuna pendliyinti vaaru duḥkhapadagalaraa? Pendlikumaarudu vaariyoddhanundi konipobadu dinamulu vachunu, appudu vaaru upa vaasamu chethuru.
evadunu paatha battaku krotthabatta maasika veyadu; vesinayedala aa maasika battanu velithiparachunu chinugu mari ekkuvagunu.

mariyu paatha thitthu lalo krottha draakshaarasamu poyaru; posinayedala thitthulu pigili, draakshaarasamu kaaripovunu, thitthulu paadagunu. Ayithe krottha draakshaarasamu krottha thitthulalo poyuduru, appudu aa rendunu chedipoka yundunani cheppenu.
aayana ee maatalu vaarithoo cheppuchundagaa, idigo oka adhikaari vachi aayanaku mrokkinaa kumaarthe yippude chanipoyinadhi, ayinanu neevu vachi nee cheyyi aamemeeda unchumu, aame bradukunanenu.
yesu lechi athani venta vellenu; aayana shishyulu kooda velliri.
aa samayamuna, idigo pandrendu samvatsaramulanundi rakthasraava rogamugala yoka stree
nenu aayana pai vastramu maatramu muttithe baagupadudunani thanalo thaanu anukoni, aayana venukaku vachi aayana vastrapu chengu muttenu.
yesu venukaku thirigi aamenu chuchi kumaaree, dhairyamugaa undumu, nee vishvaasamu ninnu baaguparachenani cheppagaa aa gadiyanundi aa stree baagu padenu.
anthalo yesu aa adhikaari yintiki vachi, pillana grovulu vaayinchu vaarini, gollu cheyuchundu janasamoohamunu chuchi
sthalamiyyudi; ee chinnadhi nidrinchuchunnadhegaani chanipoledani vaarithoo cheppagaa vaaraayananu apahasinchiri.
janasamoohamunu pampivesi, aayana lopaliki velli aame cheyyi pattukonagaane aa chinnadhi lechenu.
ee samaachaaramu aa dheshamanthatanu vyaapinchenu.
yesu akkadanundi velluchundagaa iddaru gruddivaaru aayana venta vachi daaveedu kumaarudaa, mammunu kanikarinchumani kekaluvesiri.
aayana yinta praveshinchina tharuvaatha aa gruddivaaru aayanayoddhaku vachiri. Yesu nenu idi cheyagalanani meeru nammuchunnaaraa? Ani vaari nadugagaa
vaarunammuchunnaamu prabhuvaa ani aayanathoo cheppiri. Appudaayana vaari kannulu mutti mee nammikachoppuna meeku kalugugaaka ani cheppinanthalo vaari kannulu teruvabadenu.
appudu yesu idi evarikini teliyakunda choochukonudani vaariki khandithamugaa aagnaapinchenu.
ayinanu vaaru velli aa dheshamanthata aayana keerthi prachuramuchesiri.
yesunu aayana shishyulunu velluchundagaa kondaru, dayyamupattina yoka moogavaani aayanayoddhaku theesikoni vachiri.
dayyamu vellagottabadina tharuvaatha aa mooga vaadu maatalaadagaa janasamoohamulu aashcharyapadi ishraayelulo eelaagu ennadunu kanabadaledani cheppukoniri.
ayithe parisayyulu ithadu dayyamula adhipathivalana dayyamulanu vellagottuchunnaadani cheppiri.

yesu vaari samaajamandiramulalo bodhinchuchu raajya suvaartha prakatinchuchu, prathividhamaina rogamunu prathi vidhamaina vyaadhini svasthaparachuchu, samastha pattanamula yandunu graamamulayandunu sanchaaramu chesenu.
aayana samoohamulanu chuchi, vaaru kaaparileni gorrela vale visiki chedariyunnanduna vaarimeeda kanikarapadi
kotha visthaaramegaani panivaaru koddigaa unnaaru
ganuka thana kothaku panivaarini pampumani kotha yajamaanuni vedu konudani thana shishyulathoo cheppenu.
aayana thana pandrendumandi shishyulanu pilichi, apavitraatmalanu vellagottutakunu, prathividhamaina rogamunu prathividhamaina vyaadhini svasthaparachutakunu, vaariki adhikaara micchenu.
aa pandrendumandi aposthalula perlu evanagaa, modata pethuranabadina seemonu, athani sahodarudagu andreya; jebedayi kumaarudagu yaakobu, athani sahodarudagu yohaanu;
philippu, bartolomayi; thoomaa, sunkariyaina matthayi, alphayi kumaarudagu yaakobu, thaddayiyanu maaruperugala lebbayi;
kanaaneeyudaina seemonu, aayananu appaginchina iskariyothu yoodhaa.
yesu aa pandrendumandhini pampuchu, vaarinichuchi vaarikaagnaapinchinadhemanagaa meeru anyajanula daariloniki vellakudi, samarayula ye pattanamulonainanu praveshimpakudigaani
ishraayelu vanshamuloni nashinchina gorrela yoddhake velludi.
velluchu paralokaraajyamu sameepinchi yunnadani prakatinchudi.
rogulanu svasthaparachudi, chanipoyinavaarini lepudi, kushtharogulanu shuddhulanugaa cheyudi, dayyamulanu vellagottudi. Uchithamugaa pondithiri uchithamugaa iyyudi.
mee sanchulalo bangaaramunainanu vendinainanu raaginainanu prayaanamu koraku jaalenainanu rendu angeelanainanu cheppulanainanu chethikarranainanu siddhaparachukonakudi;
panivaadu thana aahaaramunaku paatrudu kaadaa?
mariyu meeru epattanamulo nainanu graamamulonainanu praveshinchunappudu, andulo evadu yogyudo vichaaranachesi, akkadanundi velluvaraku athani yintane basacheyudi.
aa yintilo praveshinchuchu, intivaariki shubhamani cheppudi.
aa yillu yogyamainadaithe mee samaadhaanamu daanimeediki vachunu; adhi ayogyamainadaithe mee samaadhaanamu meeku thirigi vachunu.
evadainanu mimmunu cherchukonaka mee maatalu vinakundina yedala meeru aa yintinainanu aa pattanamainanu vidichipovunappudu mee paadadhooli dulipiveyudi.
vimarshadhinamandu aa pattanapu gathikante sodoma gomorraa pradheshamula gathi orvathaginadai yundunani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppu chunnaanu.
idigo thoodellamadhyaku gorrelanu pampinattu nenu mimmunu pampuchunnaanu ganuka paamulavale vivekulunu paavuramulavale nishkapatulunai yundudi.
manushyu lanugoorchi jaagratthapadudi; vaaru mimmunu mahaasabhalaku appaginchi, thama samaajamandiramulalo mimmunu koradaa lathoo kottinthuru,
veerikini anyajanulakunu saakshyaarthamai naanimitthamu meeru adhipathulayoddhakunu raajulayoddhakunu thebaduduru.
vaaru mimmunu appaginchunappudu,elaagu maataadudumu? emi cheppudumu? Ani chinthimpa kudi; meeremi cheppavaleno adhi aa gadiyalone meekanu grahimpabadunu.
mee thandri aatma meelo undi maatalaaduchunnaade gaani maatalaaduvaaru meeru kaaru.
sahodarudu sahodaruni, thandri kumaaruni, maranamunaku appaginchedaru; pillalu thalidandrulameeda lechi vaarini champinchedaru.
meeru naa naamamu nimitthamu andarichetha dveshimpabaduduru; anthamuvarakunu sahinchina vaadu rakshampabadunu.

vaaru ee pattanamulo mimmunu hinsinchunappudu mariyoka pattanamunaku paaripovudi; manushyakumaarudu vachuvaraku meeru ishraayelu pattanamulalo sanchaaramu chesiyundarani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppu chunnaanu.
shishyudu bodhakunikante adhikudu kaadu; daasudu yajamaanunikante adhikudu kaadu.

shishyudu thana bodhakunivalenu daasudu thana yajamaanunivalenu undina chaalunu. Inti yajamaanuniki bayeljeboolani vaaru perupetti yundinayedala aayana yintivaariki mari nishchayamugaa aa peru pettuduru gadaa.
kaabatti meeru vaariki bhayapadakudi, marugainadhediyu bayaluparacha badakapodu, rahasyamainadhediyu teliyabadakapodu.
chikatilo nenu meethoo cheppunadhi meeru velugulo cheppudi; chevilo meeku cheppabadinadhi medalameeda praka tinchudi.
mariyu aatmanu champaneraka dhehamune champuvaariki bhayapadakudi gaani, aatmanu dhehamunukooda narakamulo nashimpajeyagalavaaniki mikkili bhayapadudi.
rendu pichukalu kaasuku ammabadunu gadaa; ayinanu mee thandri selavuleka vaatilo okatainanu nelanu padadu.
mee thalavendrukalanniyu lekkimpabadiyunnavi
ganuka meeru bhayapadakudi; meeranekamaina pichukalakante shreshthulu.
manushyulayeduta nannu oppukonuvaadevado paralokamandunna naa thandri yeduta nenunu vaanini oppukondunu.
manushyula yeduta evadu nannu erugananuno vaanini paraloka mandunna naa thandriyeduta nenunu eruganandunu.
nenu bhoomimeediki samaadhaanamunu pampavachithinani thalanchakudi; khadgamune gaani samaadhaanamunu pamputaku nenu raaledu.
oka manushyunikini vaani thandrikini, kumaarthekunu aame thallikini, kodalikini aame atthakunu virodhamu pettavachithini.
oka manushyuni yintivaare athaniki shatruvulaguduru.
thandrinainanu thallinainanu naa kante ekkuvagaa preminchuvaadu naaku paatrudukaadu; kumaaruninainanu kumaarthenainanu naakante ekku vagaa preminchuvaadu naaku paatrudu kaadu;
thana siluvanu etthikoni nannu vembadimpanivaadu naaku paatrudu kaadu.
thana praanamu dakkinchukonuvaadu daani pogottukonunu gaani naa nimitthamu thana praanamu pogottukonuvaadu daani dakkinchukonunu.
mimmunu cherchukonuvaadu nannu cherchukonunu; nannu cherchukonuvaadu nannu pampinavaani cherchukonunu.
pravaktha ani pravakthanu cherchukonuvaadu pravakthaphalamu pondunu; neethimanthudani neethimanthuni cherchukonuvaadu neethimanthuni phalamu pondunu.
mariyu shishyudani yevadu ee chinnavaarilo okaniki ginnedu channeellu maatramu traaganichuno vaadu thana phalamu pogottu konadani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
yesu thana pandrendumandi shishyulaku aagnaapinchuta chaalinchina tharuvaatha vaari pattanamulalo bodhinchutakunu prakatinchutakunu akkadanundi vellipoyenu.
kreesthu cheyuchunna kaaryamulanu goorchi yohaanu cherasaalalo vini raabovu vaadavu neevenaa, memu mari yokanikoraku kanipettavalenaa?
ani aayananu adugutaku thana shishyulanampenu.
yesu vaarini chuchi meeru velli, vinnavaatini kannavaatini yohaanuku telupudi.

gruddivaaru choopuponduchunnaaru, kuntivaaru naduchuchunnaaru, kushtharogulu shuddhulaguchunnaaru, cheviti vaaru vinuchunnaaru, chanipoyinavaaru lepabaduchunnaaru, beedalaku suvaartha prakatimpabaduchunnadhi.
mariyu naa vishayamai abhyantharapadanivaadu dhanyudani yutthara micchenu.
vaaru vellipovuchundagaa yesu yohaanunugoorchi janasamoohamulathoo eelaagu cheppasaagenu meeremi choochutaku aranyamuloniki vellithiri? Gaaliki kadalu chunna rellunaa? Mari emi chooda vellithiri?
sannapu battalu dharinchukonna manushyunaa? Idigo sannapu battalu dharinchukonuvaaru raajagruhamulalo nunduru gadaa.
mari emi chooda vellithiri? Pravakthanaa? Avunugaani pravakthakante goppavaaninani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
idigo nenu naa doothanu neeku mundhugaa pampuchunnaanu, athadu nee mundhara nee maargamunu siddha parachunu.
streelu kaninavaarilo baapthismamichu yohaanukante goppavaadu puttaledani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppu chunnaanu. Ayinanu paralokaraajyamulo alpudaina vaadu athanikante goppavaadu.
baapthismamichu yohaanu dinamulu modalukoni yippati varaku paralokaraajyamu balaatkaaramugaa pattabaduchunnadhi, balaatkaarulu daani naakraminchukonuchunnaaru.
yohaanu kaalamu varaku pravakthalandarunu pravachinchuchuvachiri; dharmashaastramu sahaa pravachinchuchunuṁ denu.
ee sangathi nangeekarinchutaku meeku manassunte raabovu eleeyaa yithade.
vinutaku chevulugalavaadu vinugaaka.
ee tharamuvaarini dhenithoo polchudunu? Santha veedhulalo koorchuniyundi
meeku pillanagrovi oodithivigaani meeru naatyamaadaraithiri; pralaapinchithivi gaani meeru rommukottukonaraithirani thama chelikaandrathoo cheppi pilupulaatalaadukonu pilla kaayalanu poliyunnaaru.
yohaanu thinakayu traagakayuvacchenu. Ganukaveedu dayyamupattina vaadani vaaranuchunnaaru.

manushyakumaarudu thinuchunu traaguchunu vacchenu ganuka idigo veedu thindibothunu madya paaniyu sunkarulakunu paapulakunu snehithudunani vaaranuchunnaaru. Ayinanu gnaanamu gnaanamani daani kriyalanubatti theerpupondunanenu.
pimmata e ye pattanamulalo aayana visthaaramaina adbhuthamulu cheseno aa pattanamulavaaru maarumanassu pondakapovutavalana aayana vaari nitlu gaddimpasaagenu.

ayyo koraajeenaa, ayyo betsayidaa, mee madhyanu cheyabadina adbhuthamulu thooru seedonupattanamulalo cheyabadina yedala aa pattanamulavaaru poorvame gone patta kattukoni boodide vesikoni maarumanassu pondi yunduru.
vimarshadhinamandu mee gathikante thooru seedonu pattanamulavaari gathi orvathaginadai yundunani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
kapernahoomaa, aakaashamu mattunaku hechimpabadedavaa? neevu paathaalamuvaraku digi poyedavu. neelo cheyabadina adbhuthamulu sodomalo cheyabadina yedala adhi netivaraku nilichiyundunu.
vimarshadhinamandu nee gathikante sodoma dheshapuvaari gathi orvathaginadai yundunani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.

aa samayamuna yesu cheppinadhemanagaa thandree, aakaashamunakunu bhoomikini prabhuvaa, neevu gnaanulakunu vivekulakunu ee sangathulanu maruguchesi pasibaaluraku bayaluparachinaavani ninnu sthuthinchuchunnaanu.
avunu thandree, eelaagu cheyuta nee drushtiki anukoolamaayenu.

samasthamunu naa thandrichetha naa kappagimpabadi yunnadhi. thandrigaaka yevadunu kumaaruni erugadu; kumaarudu gaakanu, kumaaru devaniki aayananu bayaluparacha nuddheshinchuno vaadu gaakanu mari evadunu thandrini erugadu.
prayaasapadi bhaaramu mosikonuchunna samastha janulaaraa, naa yoddhaku randi; nenu meeku vishraanthi kaluga jethunu.
nenu saatvikudanu deenamanassu galavaadanu ganuka meemeeda naa kaadi etthikoni naayoddha nerchukonudi; appudu mee praanamulaku vishraanthi dorakunu.
yelayanagaa naa kaadi suluvugaanu naa bhaaramu thelika gaanu unnavi.
aa kaalamandu yesu vishraanthidinamuna pantachelalo padi velluchundagaa aayana shishyulu aakaligoni vennulu trunchi thinasaagiri.
parisayyuladhi chuchi idigo, vishraanthidinamuna cheyakoodanidi nee shishyulu cheyuchunnaarani aayanathoo cheppagaa
aayana vaarithoo itlanenu thaanunu thanathoo kooda nunnavaarunu aakaligoni yundagaa daaveedu chesina daanigoorchi meeru chaduva ledaa?
athadu dhevuni mandiramulo praveshinchi, yaajakule thappa thaanainanu thanathoo kooda unnavaarainanu thinakoodani samukhapu rottelu thinenu.
mariyu yaajakulu vishraanthidinamuna dhevaalayamulo vishraanthidinamunu ullanghinchiyu nirdoshulai yunnaarani meeru dharmashaastramandu chaduvaledaa?
dhevaalayamukante goppa vaadikkada nunnaadani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
mariyu kanikaramune koruchunnaanu gaani balini nenu koranu anu vaakyabhaavamu meeku telisiyunte nirdoshulanu doshulani theerpu theerchakapoduru.
kaagaa manushya kumaarudu vishraanthi dinamunaku prabhuvaiyunnaadanenu.
aayana akkadanundi velli vaari samaajamandiramulo praveshinchinappudu, idigo oochacheyyi galavaadokadu kanabadenu.
vaaraayana meeda neramu mopavalenani vishraanthidinamuna svasthaparachuta nyaayamaa? Ani aayananu adigiri.
andukaayana meelo e manushyunikainanu noka gorrayundi adhi vishraanthidinamuna guntalo padinayedala daani pattukoni paiki theeyadaa?
gorre kante manushyudenthoo shreshthudu; kaabatti vishraanthi dinamuna melucheyuta dharmame ani cheppi
aa manushyunithoo nee cheyyi chaapumanenu. Vaadu cheyyi chaapagaa rendavadaanivale adhi baagupadenu.
anthata parisayyulu velupaliki poyi, aayananu elaagu sanharinthumaa ani aayanaku virodhamugaa aalochana chesiri.
yesu aa sangathi telisikoni acchatanundi vellipoyenu. Bahu janulaayananu vembadimpagaa
aayana vaarinandarini svastha parachi, thannu prasiddhicheyavaddani vaariki aagnaapinchenu.
pravakthayaina yeshayaadvaaraa cheppinadhi neraverunatlu (aalaagu jarigenu) adhemanagaa
idigo eeyana naa sevakudu eeyananu nenu erparachukontini eeyana naa praanamuna kishtudaina naa priyudu eeyanameeda naa aatma nunchedanu eeyana anyajanulaku nyaayavidhini prachuramu cheyunu.
eeyana jagadamaadadu, kekaluveyadu veedhulalo eeyana shabdamevanikini vinabadadu
vijayamondutaku nyaayavidhini prabalamu cheyuvaraku eeyana naligina rellunu viruvadu makamakalaaduchunna avisenaaranu aarpadu
eeyana naamamandu anyajanulu nireekshinchedaru anunadiye
appudu dayyamupattina gruddivaadunu moogavaadunaina yokadu aayanayoddhaku thebadenu. aayana vaanini svasthaparachinanduna aa moogavaadu maatalaadu shakthiyu choopunu galavaadaayenu.
anduku prajalandaru vismayamondi eeyana daaveedu kumaarudu kaadaa, ani cheppukonu chundiri.
parisayyulu aa maata viniveedu dayyamulaku adhipathiyaina bayeljebooluvalanane dayyamulanu vellagottuchunnaadu gaani mariyokanivalana kaadaniri.
aayana vaari thalampula nerigi vaarithoo itlanenu thanaku thaane virodhamugaa verupadina prathi raajyamu paadaipovunu. thanakuthaane virodhamugaa verupadina ye pattanamainanu e yillayinanu niluvadu.
saathaanu saathaanunu vellagottinayedala thanakuthaane virodhamugaa verupadunu; atlayithe vaani raajyamelaagu niluchunu?
nenu bayeljebooluvalana dayyamulanu vellagottuchunna yedala mee kumaarulu evarivalana vaatini vellagottu chunnaaru? Kaabatti vaare meeku theerparulaiyunduru.
dhevuni aatmavalana nenu dayyamulanu vellagottuchunna yedala nishchayamugaa dhevuni raajyamu mee yoddhaku vachi yunnadhi.
okadu modata balavanthuni bandhimpani yedala yelaagu aa balavanthuni yintilo cochi athani saamagri dochukonagaladu? Atlu bandhinchinayedala vaani yillu dochukonunu.
naa pakshamuna nundanivaadu naaku virodhi; naathoo kalisi samakoorchanivaadu chedhara gottuvaadu.
kaabatti nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa manushyulucheyu prathi paapamunu dooshanayu vaariki kshamimpabadunu gaani aatma vishayamaina dooshanaku paapa kshamaapana ledu.
manushyakumaaruniki virodhamugaa maatalaaduvaaniki paapakshamaapana kaladugaani parishuddhaatmaku virodhamugaa maatalaaduvaaniki ee yugamandainanu raabovu yugamandainanu paapakshamaapana ledu.
chettu manchidani yenchi daani pandunu manchidhe ani yenchudi; ledaa, chettu cheddadani yenchi daani pandunu cheddadhe ani yenchudi. chettu daani panduvalana teliyabadunu.
sarpasanthaanamaa, meeru cheddavaaraiyundi elaagu manchi maatalu palukagalaru? Hrudayamandu nindiyundu daaninibatti noru maatalaadunu gadaa.
sajjanudu thana manchi dhananidhilo nundi sadvishayamulanu techunu; durjanudu thana chedda dhananidhilonundi durvishayamulanu techunu.
nenu meethoo cheppunadhemanagaa manushyulu paluku vyarthamaina prathi maatanugoorchiyu vimarshadhinamuna lekka cheppavalasiyundunu.
nee maatalanubatti neethi manthudavani theerpunonduduvu, nee maatalanubattiye apa raadhivani theerpunonduduvu.
appudu shaastrulalonu parisayyulalonu kondarubodhakudaa, neevalana oka soochakakriya choodagoru chunnaamani aayanathoo cheppagaa aayana itlanenu.
vyabhichaarulaina chedda tharamuvaaru soochaka kriyanu adugu chunnaaru. Pravakthayaina yonaanugoorchina soochaka kriyaye gaani mari e soochaka kriyayainanu vaariki anugrahimpabadadu.
yonaa moodu raatrimbagallu thivingilamu kadupulo elaagundeno aalaagu manushya kumaarudu moodu raatrimbagallu bhoogarbamulo undunu.

neenevevaaru yonaa prakatana vini maaru manassu pondiri ganuka vimarsha samayamuna neenevevaaru ee tharamuvaarithoo niluvabadi vaarimeeda nerasthaapana chethuru. Idigo yonaakante goppavaadu ikkada unnaadu.

vimarsha samayamuna dakshinadheshapuraani yee tharamu vaarithoo niluvabadi vaarimeeda nerasthaapana cheyunu; aame solomonu gnaanamu vinutaku bhoomyantha mulanundivacchenu; idigo solomonukante goppavaadu ikkada unnaadu.
apavitraatma oka manushyuni vadalipoyina tharuvaatha adhi vishraanthivedakuchu neeruleni chootla thiruguchundunu.

vishraanthi dorakanandunanenu vadalivachina naa yintiki thirigi velludunanukoni vachi, aa yinta evarunu leka adhi oodchi amarchiyundutachuchi, velli thanakante cheddavaina mari yedu dayyamulanu ventabettukoni vachunu; avi daanilo praveshinchi akkadane kaapuramundunu.
anduchetha aa manushyuni kadapatisthithi modatisthithikante cheddadagunu. aalaage yee dushtatharamuvaarikini sambhavinchu nanenu.
aayana janasamoohamulathoo inka maatalaaduchundagaa idigo aayana thalliyu sahodarulunu aayanathoo maatalaada goruchu velupala nilichiyundiri.
appudokadu idigo nee thalliyu nee sahodarulunu neethoo maatalaada valenani velupala nilichiyunnaarani aayanathoo cheppenu.
andukaayana thanathoo ee sangathi cheppinavaanichuchi naa thalli yevaru? Naa sahodaru levaru? Ani cheppi
thana shishyulavaipu cheyyi chaapi idigo naa thalliyu naa sahodarulunu;
paralokamandunna naa thandri chitthamu choppuna cheyuvaade naa sahodarudunu, naa sahodariyu, naathalliyu nanenu.
aa dinamandu yesu intanundi velli samudratheeramuna koorchundenu.
bahu janasamoohamulu thana yoddhaku koodivachinanduna aayana doneyekki koorchundenu. aa janulandaru darini nilichiyundagaa
aayana vaarini chuchi chaala sangathulanu upamaana reethigaa cheppenu. Etlanagaa idigo vitthuvaadu vitthutaku bayalu vellenu.
vaadu vitthuchundagaa konni vitthanamulu trovaprakkanu padenu; pakshulu vachivaatini mingivesenu
konni chaala mannuleni raathinelanu padenu; akkada mannu lothugaa undananduna avi ventane molichenu gaani
sooryudu udayinchinappudu avi maadi verulenanduna endipoyenu.
konni mundlapodalalo padenu; mundlapodalu edigi
konni manchi nelanu padi, okati nooranthalugaanu, okati aruvadanthalugaanu, okati muppa danthalugaanu phalinchenu.
chevulugalavaadu vinunugaaka ani cheppenu.
tharuvaatha shishyulu vachineevu upamaanareethigaa enduku vaarithoo maatalaaduchunnaavani aayananu adugagaa, aayana vaarithoo itlanenu
paraloka raajyamarmamulu eruguta meeku anugrahimpabadiyunnadhi gaani vaariki anugrahimpa badaledu.

kaliginavaanike yiyyabadunu, vaaniki samruddhi kalugunu; lenivaaniki kaliginadhiyu vaaniyoddhanundi theesi veyabadunu. Mariyuvaaru choochuchundiyu choodaru, vinuchundiyu vinakayu grahimpakayu nunnaaru.
indu nimitthamu nenu upamaanareethigaa vaariki bodhinchu chunnaanu.ee prajalu kannulaara chuchi, chevulaaraa vini, hrudayamuthoo grahinchi
manassu trippukoni naavalana svasthatha pondakundunatlu vaari hrudayamu krovvinadhi, vaari chevulu vinutaku mandamulainavi, vaaru thama kannulu moosikoniyunnaaru
ganuka meeru vinutamattuku vindurugaani grahimpane grahamparu, choochutamattuku choothurugaani yentha maatramunu telisikonaru ani yeshayaa cheppina pravachanamu veeri vishayamai neraveruchunnadhi.
ayithe mee kannulu choochuchunnavi ganuka avi dhanyamulainavi, mee chevulu vinuchunnavi ganuka avi dhanyamulainavi.
aneka pravakthalunu neethimanthulunu meeru choochuvaatini choodagoriyu choodaka poyiri, meeru vinuvaatini vinagoriyu vinakapoyirani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
vitthuvaani goorchina upamaana bhaavamu vinudi.
evadainanu raajyamunugoorchina vaakyamu viniyu grahimpaka yundagaa, dushtudu vachi vaani hrudayamulo vitthabadinadaanini yetthikonipovunu; trova prakkanu vitthabadinavaadu veede.
raathinelanu vitthabadinavaadu vaakyamu vini ventane santhooshamuthoo daani nangeekarinchuvaadu.
ayithe athanilo veru lenanduna athadu konthakaalamu niluchunu gaani, vaakyamu nimitthamu shramayainanu hinsayainanu kalugagaane abhyanthara padunu.
mundlapodalalo vittha badinavaadu vaakyamu vinuvaade gaani aihikavichaaramunu dhanamohamunu aa vaakyamunu anachiveyunu ganuka vaadu nishphaludavunu.
manchinelanu vitthabadinavaadu vaakyamu vini grahinchuvaadu; attivaaru saphalulai yokadu nooranthalugaanu okadu aruvadanthalugaanu okadu muppadanthalugaanu phalinchunanenu.
aayana mariyoka upamaanamu vaarithoo cheppenu, emanagaaparalokaraajyamu, thana polamulo manchi vitthanamu vitthina yoka manushyuni poliyunnadhi.
manushyulu nidrinchuchundagaa, athani shatruvu vachi godhumala madhyanu gurugulu vitthipoyenu.
molakalu perigi ginjapattinappudu gurugulu kooda agapadenu.
appudu inti yajamaanuni daasulu athaniyoddhaku vachi ayyaa, neevu nee polamulo manchi vitthanamu vitthithivi gadaa,andulo gurugu lekkadanundi vachinavani adigiri.
idi shatruvu chesina pani ani athadu vaarithoo cheppagaa, aa daasulu memu velli vaatini periki koorchuta neekishtamaa? Ani athanini adigiri.
andukathadu vaddu; gurugulanu perukuchundagaa, vaatithookooda okavela godhumalanu pellaginthuru.

kothakaalamuvaraku rentinikalisi yeduga niyyudi; kothakaalamandu gurugulanu mundhugaakoorchi vaatini kaalchiveyutaku kattalu katti, godhumalanu naa kottulo cherchi pettudani kothagaandrathoo cheppudunanenu.
aayana mariyoka upamaanamu vaarithoo cheppenu paralokaraajyamu, okadu theesikoni thana polamulo vitthina aavaginjanu poliyunnadhi.
adhi vitthanamulannitilo chinnadhegaani periginappudu koora mokkalannitilo peddadai aakaashapakshulu vachi daani kommalayandu nivasinchu nantha chettagunu.
aayana mariyoka upamaanamu vaarithoo cheppenu paralokaraajyamu, oka stree theesikoni pindi anthayu pulisi ponguvaraku moodu kunchamula pindilo daachi pettina pullani pindini poliyunnadhi.
nenu naa noru terachi upamaanareethigaa bodhinchedanu, lokamu puttinadhi modalukoni marugucheyabadina sangathulanu teliyajeppedanu
ani pravaktha cheppinamaata neraverunatlu yesu ee sangathulanannitini janasamoohamulaku upamaanareethigaa bodhiṁ chenu; upamaanamu leka vaarikemiyu bodhimpaledu.
appudaayana janasamoohamulanu pampivesi, yinti loniki vellagaa aayana shishyulaayanayoddhaku vachipolamu loni gurugulanu goorchina upamaanabhaavamu maaku teliyajeppumaniri.
andukaayana itlanenu manchi vitthanamu vitthuvaadu manushyakumaarudu;
polamu lokamu; manchi vitthanamulu raajyasambandhulu; gurugulu dushtuni sambandhulu;
vaatini vitthina shatruvu apavaadhi; kotha yugasamaapthi; kothakoyuvaaru dhevadoothalu.
gurugulu elaagu koorchabadi agnilo kaalchiveyabaduno aalaage yuga samaapthiyandu jarugunu.
manushyakumaarudu thana doothalanu pampunu; vaaraayana raajyamulonundi aatankamulagu sakalamainavaatini durneethiparulanu samakoorchi agnigundamulo padaveyuduru.
akkada edpunu pandlukorukutayunu undunu.
appudu neethimanthulu thama thandri raajyamulo sooryunivale thejarilluduru. chevulugalavaadu vinunugaaka.
paralokaraajyamu, polamulo daachabadina dhanamunu poliyunnadhi. Oka manushyudu daani kanugoni daachi petti, adhi dorikina santhooshamuthoo velli, thanaku kaligina danthayu ammi aa polamunu konunu.
mariyu paralokaraajyamu, manchi mutyamulanu kona vedakuchunna varthakuni poliyunnadhi.
athadu amoolyamaina yoka mutyamunu kanugoni, poyi thanaku kaligina danthayu ammi daani konunu.
mariyu paralokaraajyamu, samudramulo veyabadi naanaavidhamulaina chepalanu pattina valanu poliyunnadhi.
adhi nindinappudu daanini dariki laagi, koorchundi, manchi vaatini gampalalo cherchi cheddavaatini bayata paaraveyu duru.
aalaage yugasamaapthiyandu jarugunu. dhevadoothalu vachi neethimanthulalonundi dushtulanu veruparachi,
veerini agni gundamulo padaveyuduru. Akkada edpunu pandlukorukutayunu undunu.
veetinannitini meeru grahinchithiraa ani vaarini adugagaa vaarugrahinchithi maniri.

aayana anduvalana paralokaraajyamulo shishyudugaacherina prathishaastriyu thana dhananidhilonundi krottha padaarthamulanu paatha padaarthamulanu velupaliki techu inti yajamaanuni poliyunnaadani vaarithoo cheppenu.
yesu ee upamaanamulu cheppi chaalinchina tharuvaatha, aayana akkada nundi velli svadheshamunaku vachi, samaaja mandiramulalo vaariki bodhinchuchundenu.
anduvalana vaaraashcharyapadi ee gnaanamunu ee adbhuthamulunu ithani kekkadanundi vachinavi?
ithadu vadlavaani kumaarudu kaadaa? Ithani thalliperu mariya kaadaa? Yaakobu yosepu seemonu yoodhaayanuvaaru ithani sodarulu kaaraa?
ithani sodareemanulandaru manathoone yunnaaru kaaraa? Ithaniki ee kaaryamulanniyu ekkadanundi vacchenani cheppukoni aayana vishayamai abhyantharapadiri.
ayithe yesupravaktha thana dheshamu lonu thana intanu thappa, mari ekkadanainanu ghanaheenudu kaadani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaari avishvaasamunubatti aayana akkada anekamaina adbhuthamulu cheyaledu.
aa samayamandu chathurthaadhipathiyaina herodu yesunugoorchina samaachaaramu vini
ithadu baapthismamichu yohaanu; athadu mruthulalonundi lechi yunnaadu; anduvalanane adbhuthamulu athaniyandu kriyaaroopakamulaguchunnavani thana sevakulathoo cheppenu.
yelayanagaaneevu nee sodarudaina philippu bhaaryayagu herodiyanu unchukonuta nyaayamu kaadani yohaanu cheppagaa,
herodu aame nimitthamu yohaanunu pattukoni bandhinchi cherasaalalo veyinchi yundenu.
athadu ithani champagorenu gaani janasamoohamu ithanini pravakthayani yenchinanduna vaariki bhayapadenu.
ayithe herodu janmadhinotsavamu vachinappudu herodiya kumaarthe vaarimadhya naatyamaadi herodunu santhoosha parachenu
ganuka'aame emi adiginanu icchedhanani athadu pramaanapoorvakamugaa vaagdaanamu chesenu.
appudaame thanathallichetha prerepimpabadinadai baapthismamichu yohaanu thalanu ikkada pallemulo petti naa kippinchumani yadigenu.
raaju duḥkhapadinanu thaanu chesina pramaanamu nimitthamunu, thanathoo kooda bhojanamunaku koorchunnavaari nimitthamunu iyyanaagnaapinchi
bantrauthunu pampi cherasaalalo yohaanu thala gottinchenu.
vaadathani thala pallemulopetti techi aa chinnadaanikicchenu; aame thana thalliyoddhaku daani theesikoni vacchenu.
anthata yohaanu shishyulu vachi shavamunu etthikonipoyi paathi petti yesunoddhakuvachi teliyajesiri.
yesu aa sangathi vini done yekki, akkadanundi aranyapradheshamunaku ekaanthamugaa vellenu. Janasamoohamulu aa sangathi vini, pattanamulanundi kaalinadakanu aayanaventa velliri.
aayana vachi aa goppa samoohamunu chuchi, vaarimeeda kanikarapadi, vaarilo rogulaina vaarini svasthaparachenu.
saayankaalamainappudu shishyu laayanayoddhaku vachi'idi aranyapradheshamu, ippatike proddupoyenu, ee janulu graamamulaloniki velli bhojanapadaarthamulu konukkonutakai vaarini pampiveyamani cheppiri.
yesuvaaru vellanakkaraledu, meere vaariki bhojanamu pettudani vaarithoo cheppagaa
vaaru ikkada manayoddha ayidu rottelunu rendu chepalunu thappa maremiyu ledani aayanathoo cheppiri.
andu kaayana vaatini naayoddhaku tendani cheppi

pachikameeda koorchundudani janulakaagnaapinchi, aa ayidu rottelanu rendu chepalanu pattukoni aakaashamuvaipu kannuletthi aasheervadhinchi aa rottelu virichi shishyulakicchenu, shishyulu janulaku vaddinchiri.
vaarandaru thini trupthipondina tharuvaatha migilina mukkalu pandrendu gampala ninda etthiri
streelunu pillalunu gaaka thininavaaru inchuminchu ayidu velamandi purushulu.
ventane aa janasamoohamulanu thaanu pampiveyunanthalo thana shishyulu done yekki thanakante mundhugaa addariki vellavalenani aayana vaarini balavanthamu chesenu.
aayana aa janasamoohamulanu pampivesi, praarthanacheyutaku ekaanthamugaa kondayekki poyi, saayankaalamainappudu ontarigaa undenu.
appatikaadone dariki dooramuganundagaa gaali yedurainanduna alalavalana kotta baduchundenu.
raatri naalugava jaamuna aayana samudramumeeda naduchuchu vaariyoddhaku vacchenu
aayana samudramumeeda naduchuta shishyulu chuchi tondharapadi, bhoothamani cheppukoni bhayamuchetha kekaluvesiri.
ventane yesudhairyamu techukonudi; nene, bhayapadakudanivaarithoo cheppagaa
pethuru prabhuvaa, neeve ayithe neellameeda nadichi neeyoddhaku vachutaku naaku selavimmani aayanathoo anenu.
aayana rammanagaane pethuru donedigi yesunoddhaku vellutaku neellameeda nadachenu gaani
gaalini chuchi bhayapadi munigiposaagi-prabhuvaa, nannu rakshinchumani kekaluvesenu.
ventane yesu cheyyichaapi athani pattukoni alpavishvaasee, yenduku sandhehapadithivani athanithoo cheppenu.
vaaru done yekkinappudu gaali anigenu.
anthata donelo nunnavaaru vachineevu nijamugaa dhevuni kumaarudavani cheppi aayanaku mrokkiri.
vaaraddariki velli gennesarethu dheshamunaku vachiri.
akkadi janulu aayananu gurthupatti, chuttupatlanunna aa pradheshamanthatiki varthamaanamu pampi, rogulanandarini aayana yoddhaku teppinchi
veerini nee vastrapuchengu maatramu muttanimmani aayananu vedukoniri; muttinavaarandarunu svasthathanondiri.
aa samayamuna yerooshalemunundi shaastrulunu parisayyulunu yesunoddhaku vachi
nee shishyulu chethulu kadugukonakunda bhojanamu cheyuchunnaare, vaarendu nimitthamu peddala paaramparyaachaaramunu athikraminchu chunnaarani adigiri
andukaayana meerunu meepaaraṁ paryaachaaramu nimitthamai dhevuni aagnanu enduku athikra minchuchunnaaru?
thalidandrulanu ghanaparachumaniyu, thandrinainanu thallinainanu dooshinchuvaadu thappaka maranamu pondavalenaniyu dhevudu selachicchenu.

meeraithe okadu thana thandrinainanu thallinainanu chuchi naavalana neekedi prayojanamaguno adhi dhevaarpithamani cheppina yedala athadu thana thandrinainanu thallinainanu ghanaparachanakkaraledani cheppuchunnaaru.
meeru mee paaramparyaachaaramu nimitthamai dhevuni vaakyamunu nirarthakamu cheyuchunnaaru.
veshadhaarulaaraa
ee prajalu thama pedavulathoo nannu ghanaparachuduru gaani vaari hrudayamu naaku dooramugaa unnadhi;
manushyulu kalpinchina paddhathulu daivopadheshamulani bodhinchuchu vaaru nannu vyarthamugaa aaraadhinchu chunnaaru ani yeshayaa mimmunugoorchi pravachinchina maata sariye ani vaarithoo cheppi
janasamoohamulanu pilichi meeru vini grahinchudi;
notapadunadhi manushyuni apavitra parachadu gaani notanundi vachuna diye manushyuni apa vitraparachunani vaarithoo cheppenu.
anthata aayana shishyulu vachiparisayyulu aa maata vini abhyantharapadirani neeku teliyunaa ani aayananu adugagaa
aayana paralokamandunna naa thandri naatani prathi mokkayu pellagimpabadunu.
vaari joliki pokudi; vaaru gruddivaaraiyundi gruddivaariki trova choopuvaaru. Gruddivaadu gruddivaaniki trova choopina yedala vaariddaru guntalo paduduru gadaa anenu.
andukupethuru ee upamaanabhaavamu maaku telupumani aayananu adugagaa
aayanameerunu inthavaraku avivekulaiyunnaaraa?
notiloniki povuna danthayu kadupulopadi bahirbhoomilo viduvabadunu gaani
notanundi bayatiki vachunavi hrudayamulo nundi vachunu; ive manushyuni apavitraparachunavani meeru grahimparaa?
duraalochanalu narahatyalu vyabhichaaramulu veshyaagamanamulu dongathanamulu abaddhasaakshya mulu dhevadooshanalu hrudayamulo nundiye vachunu
ive manushyuni apavitraparachunu gaani chethulu kadugu konaka bhojanamucheyuta manushyuni apavitraparachadani cheppenu.
yesu akkadanundi bayaludheri thooru seedonula praanthamulaku vellagaa,
idigo aa praanthamulanundi kanaanu stree yokate vachiprabhuvaa, daaveedu kumaarudaa, nannu karunimpumu; naa kumaarthe dayyamupatti, bahu baadhapaduchunnadani kekaluvesenu.
andukaayana aamethoo okka maatayainanu cheppaledu. Appudaayana shishyulu vachi'eeme mana vembadi vachi kekaluveyu chunnadhi ganuka eemenu pampi veyumani aayananu vedukonagaa
aayana'ishraayelu intivaarai nashinchina gorrelayoddhake gaani mari evariyoddhakunu nenu pampabada ledanenu
ayinanu aame vachi aayanaku mrokki prabhuvaa, naaku sahaayamu cheyumani adigenu.
andukaayanapillala rottetheesikoni kukkapillalakuveyuta yukthamu kaadani cheppagaa
aamenijame prabhuvaa, kukkapillalukooda thama yajamaanula ballameedanundi padu mukkalu thinunu gadaa ani cheppenu.
anduku yesu ammaa, nee vishvaasamu goppadhi; neevu korinatte neeku avunugaaka ani aamethoo cheppenu. aa gadiyalone aame kumaarthe svasthatha nondhenu.
yesu akkadanundi velli, galilaya samudratheeramunaku vachi, kondekki akkada koorchundagaa
bahu janasamoohamulu aayanayoddhaku kuntivaaru gruddivaaru moogavaaru angaheenulu modalaina anekulanu theesikonivachi aayana paadamulayoddha padavesiri; aayana vaarini svasthaparachenu.
moogavaaru maatalaadu tayunu angaheenulu baagupadutayunu kuntivaaru naduchutayunu gruddivaaru choochutayunu janasamoo hamu chuchi aashcharyapadi ishraayelu dhevuni mahima parachiri.

anthata yesu thana shishyulanu pilichi ee janulu netiki moodu dinamulanundi naayoddha nunnaaru; vaariki thina nemiyu ledu ganuka vaarimeeda kanikarapaduchunnaanu; vaaru maargamulo moorchapovuduremo ani vaarini upavaasamuthoo pampiveyutaku naaku manassu ledani vaarithoo cheppagaa
aayana shishyulu'intha goppa jana samoohamunu trupthiparachutaku kaavalasina rottelu aranyapradheshamulo manaku ekkadanundi vachunani aayanathoo aniri.
yesumeeyoddha enni rottelunnavani vaari nadugagaa vaaru'edu rottelunu konni chinna chepalunu unnavani cheppiri.
appudaayana nelameeda koorchundudani janasamoohamunaku aagnaapinchi
aa yedu rottelanu aa chepalanu pattukoni kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchi vaatini virichi thana shishyulakicchenu, shishyulu jana samoohamunaku vaddinchiri
vaarandaru thini trupthi pondinameedata migilina mukkalu edu gampala ninda etthiri.
streelunu pillalunu gaaka thininavaaru naaluguvela mandi purushulu.
tharuvaatha aayana janasamoohamulanu pampivesi, doneyekki magadaanu praanthamulaku vacchenu.
appudu parisayyulunu saddookayyulunu vachi aayananu shodhinchutaku aakaashamunundi yoka soochaka kriyanu thamaku choopumani aayananu adugagaa aayana itlanenu
saayankaalamuna meeru aakaashamu erragaa unnadhi ganuka varshamu kuriyadaniyu,
udayamuna aakaashamu erragaanu mabbugaanu unnadhi ganuka nedu gaalivaana vachunaniyu cheppuduru gadaa. meeru aakaasha vaikhari vivechimpa neruguduru gaani yee kaalamula soochanalanu vivechimpaleru.

vyabhichaarulaina cheddatharamu vaaru soochaka kriya naduguchunnaaru, ayithe yonaanu goorchina soochakakriyayegaani mari e soochaka kriyayaina vaari kanugrahimpabadadani vaarithoo cheppi vaarini vidichi vellipoyenu.
aayana shishyulu addariki vachi rottelu techutaku marachiri.
appudu yesu choochukonudi, parisayyulu saddookayyulu anu vaari pulisina pindinigoorchi jaagrattha padudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
kaagaa vaaru manamu rottelu thenanduna gadaa (yee maata cheppenani) thamalo thaamu aalochinchukonuchundiri.
yesu adhi yerigi alpavishvaasulaaraa manayoddha rottelu levani meelo meerenduku aalochinchukonuchunnaaru?
meerinkanu grahimpaledaa? Ayidu rottelu ayiduvelamandiki panchipettinappudu enni gampellu etthithiro adhiyainanu
edu rottelu naalugu velamandiki panchipettinappudu enni gampellu etthithiro adhiyainanu meeku gnaapakamu ledaa?
nenu rottelanugoorchi meethoo cheppaledani meerenduku grahimparu? Parisayyulu saddookayyulu anuvaari pulisina pindinigoorchiye jaagratthapadudani cheppenu.
appudu rottela pulisina pindinigoorchi kaadugaani parisayyulu saddookayyulu anuvaari bodhanu goorchiye jaagratthapadavalenani aayana thamathoo cheppenani vaaru grahinchiri.
yesu philippudaina kaisaraya praanthamulaku vachimanushyakumaarudevadani janulu cheppakonuchunnaarani thana shishyulanu adugagaa
vaarukondaru baapthismamichu yohaananiyu, kondaru eleeyaa aniyu, kondaru yirmeeyaa aniyu leka pravaktha lalo okadaniyu cheppukonuchunnaaraniri.
andukaayana meeraithe nenu evadanani cheppukonuchunnaa rani vaari nadigenu.
anduku seemonu pethuru neevu sajeevudagu dhevuni kumaarudavaina kreesthuvani cheppenu.
anduku yesu seemonu bar‌yonaa, neevu dhanyudavu, paralokamandunna naa thandri ee sangathi neeku bayaluparachenekaani narulu neeku bayalu parachaledu.
mariyu neevu pethuruvu; ee bandameeda naa sanghamunu kattudunu, paathaalaloka dvaaramulu daani yeduta niluvaneravani nenu neethoo cheppuchunnaanu.

paralokaraajyamuyokka thaalapuchevulu nee kicchedanu, neevu bhoolokamandu dheni bandhinchuduvo adhi paraloka mandunu bandhimpabadunu, bhoolokamandu dheni vippuduvo adhi paralokamandunu vippabadunani athanithoo cheppenu.
atupimmata thaanu kreesthu ani yevanithoonu cheppavaddani aayana thana shishyulaku khandithamugaa aagnaapinchenu.

appatinundi thaanu yerooshalemunaku vellipeddalachethanu pradhaana yaajakulachethanu shaastrulachethanu aneka hinsalu pondi, champabadi, moodavadhinamuna lechuta agatyamani yesu thana shishyulaku teliyajeya modalupettagaa
pethuru aayana cheyi pattukoniprabhuvaa, adhi neeku dooramagugaaka, adhi nee kennadunu kalugadani aayananu gaddimpasaagenu.

ayithe aayana pethuruvaipu thirigi saathaanaa, naa venukaku pommu; neevu naaku abhyanthara kaaranamaiyunnaavu; neevu manushyula sangathulane thalanchuchunnaavu gaani dhevuni sangathulanu thalampaka yunnaavani pethuruthoo cheppenu.
appudu yesu thana shishyulanu chuchi'evadainanu nannu vembadimpagorina yedala, thannuthaanu upekshinchukoni, thana siluvanetthikoni nannu vembadimpavalenu.
thana praanamunu rakshinchu konagoruvaadu daani pogottukonunu; naa nimitthamuthana praanamunu pogottukonuvaadu daani dakkinchu konunu.
oka manushyudu lokamanthayu sampaadhinchu koni thana praanamunu pogottukonte athanikemi prayo janamu? Oka manushyudu thana praanamunaku prathigaa nemi yiyyagaladu?
manushyakumaarudu thana thandri mahima galavaadai thana doothalathoo kooda raabovuchunnaadu. Appu daayana evani kriyalachoppuna vaaniki phalamichunu.
ikkada nilichiyunna vaarilokondaru, manushyakumaarudu thana raajyamuthoo vachuta choochuvaraku maranamu ruchi choodarani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
aaru dinamulaina tharuvaatha yesu pethurunu yaakobunu athani sahodarudaina yohaanunu venta bettukoni yetthayina yoka kondameediki ekaanthamugaa poyi vaari yeduta roopaantharamu pondhenu.
aayana mukhamu sooryunivale prakaashinchenu; aayana vastramulu veluguvale tellanivaayenu.
idigo mosheyu eleeyaayu vaariki kanabadi aayanathoo maata laaduchundiri.
appudu pethuru prabhuvaa, mamikkada unduta manchidi; neekishtamaithe ikkada neeku okatiyu mosheku okatiyu eleeyaaku okatiyu moodu parnashaalalu kattudunani yesuthoo cheppenu.

athadu inkanu maatalaaduchundagaa idigo prakaashamaanamaina yoka meghamu vaarini kammukonenu; idigo eeyana naa priyakumaarudu, eeyanayandu nenaanandinchuchunnaanu, eeyana maata vinudani yoka shabdamu aa meghamulonundi puttenu.
shishyulu ee maata vini borlabadi mikkili bhayapadagaa
yesu vaariyoddhaku vachi vaarini muttilendi, bhayapadakudani cheppenu.
vaaru kannuletthi choodagaa, yesu thappa mari evarunu vaariki kanabadaledu.
vaaru konda digi vachuchundagaa manushyakumaarudu mruthulalonundi lechuvaraku ee darshanamu meeru evari thoonu cheppakudani yesu vaari kaagnaapinchenu.
appudaayana shishyulu eelaagaithe eleeyaa mundhugaa raavale nani shaastrulenduku cheppuchunnaarani aayana nadigiri.
andukaayana eleeyaa vachi samasthamunu chakkapettu nanu maata nijame;

ayinanu eleeyaa yidivarake vacchenu; vaarathanini erugaka thama kishtamu vachinattu athani yedala chesiri. Manushyakumaarudu kooda aalaage vaari chetha shramalu pondabovuchunnaadani meethoo cheppu chunnaananenu.
appudaayana baapthismamichu yohaanunugoorchi thamathoo cheppenani shishyulu grahinchiri.
vaaru janasamoohamunoddhaku vachinappudu okadu aayanayoddhaku vachi aayanayeduta mokaallooni
prabhuvaa, naa kumaaruni karunimpumu; vaadu chaandra rogiyai mikkili baadhapaduchunnaadu; elaaganagaa agni lonu neellalonu tharuchugaa paduchunnaadu;
nee shishyula yoddhaku vaanini theesikoni vachithini gaani vaaru vaanini svasthaparachalekapoyirani cheppenu.
anduku yesuvishvaasamuleni moorkhatharamuvaaralaaraa, meethoo nenentha kaalamu undunu? Enthavaraku mimmunu sahinthunu? Vaanini naayoddhaku theesikonirandani cheppenu.
anthata yesu aa dayyamunu gaddimpagaa adhi vaanini vadali poyenu; aa gadiyanundi aa chinnavaadu svasthatha nondhenu.
tharuvaatha shishyulu ekaanthamugaa yesu noddhaku vachimemenduchetha daanini vellagottaleka pothi mani adigiri.
andukaayanamee alpavishvaasamu chethane; meeku aavaginjantha vishvaasamundinayedala ee kondanu chuchi ikkadanundi akkadiki pommanagaane adhi povunu;
meeku asaadhyamainadhi ediyu nundadani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo anenu.
vaaru galilayalo sancharinchuchundagaa yesumanushyakumaarudu manushyulachethiki appagimpabadabovu chunnaadu,
vaaraayananu champuduru; moodavadhinamuna aayana lechunani vaarithoo cheppagaa vaaru bahugaa duḥkhapadiri.
vaaru kapernahoomunaku vachinappudu arashekelu anu pannu vasoolucheyuvaaru pethurunoddhakuvachi mee bodhakudu ee arashekelu chellimpadaa ani yadu gagaachellinchunanenu.
athadu intiloniki vachi maata laadakamunupe yesu aa sangathi yetthiseemonaa, neekemi thoochuchunnadhi? bhooraajulu sunkamunu pannunu evari yoddha vasoolucheyuduru? Kumaarulayoddhanaa ana
athadu anyulayoddhane ani cheppagaa yesu alaagaithe kumaarulu svathantrule.

ayinanu manamu vaariki abhyantharamu kalugajeyakundunatlu neevu samudramunaku poyi, gaalamu vesi, modata paikivachu chepanu pattukoni, daani noru terachinayedala oka shekelu dorakunu; daanini theesikoni naa korakunu neekorakunu vaarikimmani athanithoo cheppenu.
aa kaalamuna shishyulu yesunoddhaku vachi, paraloka raajyamulo evadu goppavaadani adugagaa,
aayana yoka chinnabiddanu thanayoddhaku pilichi, vaari madhyanu niluvabetti yitlanenu
meeru maarpunondi biddalavanti vaaraithene gaani paralokaraajyamulo praveshimparani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
kaagaa ee biddavale thannuthaanu thagginchukonuvaadevado vaade paralokaraajyamulo goppavaadu.
mariyu eelaati yoka biddanu naa perata cherchukonuvaadu nannu cherchu konunu.
naayandu vishvaasamunchu ee chinna vaarilo okanini abhyantharaparachuvaadevado, vaadu medaku pedda thirugatiraayi kattabadinavaadai mikkili lothaina samudramulo munchi veyabaduta vaaniki melu.
abhyantharamulavalana lokamunaku shrama; abhyantharamulu raaka thappavu gaani, yevanivalana abhyantharamu vachuno aa manushyuniki shrama

kaagaa nee cheyyiyainanu nee paadamainanu ninnu abhyantharaparachinayedala, daanini nariki neeyoddhanundi paaraveyumu; rendu chethulunu rendu paadamulunu kaligi nityaagnilo padaveyabadutakante kuntivaadavugano angaheenudavugano jeevamulo prave shinchuta neeku melu.
nee kannu ninnu abhyantharaparachina yedala daani periki neeyoddhanundi paaraveyumu; rendu kannulu galigi agnigala narakamulo padaveyabadutakante oka kannu galigi jeevamulo praveshinchuta neeku melu.
ee chinnavaarilo okaninainanu truneekarimpakunda choochukonudi. Veeri doothalu, paralokamandunna naa thandri mukhamunu ellappudu paralokamandu choochuchundurani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
meekemi thoochunu? Oka manushyuniki nooru gorrelundagaa vaatilo okati thappipoyina yedala
tombadhitommidintini kondalameeda vidichivelli thappipoyinadaanini vedakadaa?
vaadu daani kanugonina yedala tombadhitommidi gorrelanugoorchi santhooshinchu nanthakante daaninigoorchi yekku vagaa santhooshinchunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
aalaagunane ee chinnavaarilo okadainanu nashinchuta paralokamandunna mee thandri chitthamukaadu.
mariyu nee sahodarudu neeyedala thappidamu chesina yedala neevu poyi, neevunu athadunu ontarigaanunnappudu athanini gaddinchumu; athadu nee maata vininayedala nee sahodaruni sampaadhinchukontivi.
athadu vinaniyedala, iddaru mugguru saakshula nota prathi maata sthiraparachabadunatlu neevu okariniddarini ventabettukoni athaniyoddhaku pommu.
athadu vaari maatayu vinaniyedala aa sangathi sanghamunaku teliyajeppumu; athadu sanghapu maatayu vinaniyedala athanini neeku anyunigaanu sunkarigaanu enchukonumu.
bhoomimeeda meeru vetini bandhinthuro, avi paralokamandunu bandhimpabadunu; bhoomimeeda meeru vetini vippuduro, avi paralokamandunu vippa badunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
mariyu meelo iddaru thaamu vedukonu dheninigoorchiyainanu bhoomimeeda ekeebhavinchinayedala adhi paralokamandunna naathandrivalana vaariki dorakunani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
yelayanagaa iddaru mugguru naa naamamuna ekkada koodi yunduro akkada nenu vaari madhyana undunani cheppenu.
aa samayamuna pethuru aayanayoddhaku vachi prabhuvaa, naa sahodarudu naayedala thappidamu chesina yedala nenennimaarulu athani kshamimpavalenu? edu maarulamattukaa? Ani adigenu.
anduku yesu athanithoo itlanenu edumaarulu mattuke kaadu, debbadhi ella maarulamattukani neethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
kaavuna paralokaraajyamu, thana daasulayoddha lekka choochukona gorina yoka raajunu poliyunnadhi.
athadu lekka choochukona modalupettinappudu, athaniki padhivela thalaanthulu achiyunna yokadu athaniyoddhaku thebadenu.
appu theerchutaku vaaniyoddha emiyu lenanduna, vaani yajamaanudu vaanini, vaani bhaaryanu, pillalanu vaaniki kaliginadhi yaavatthunu ammi, appu theerchavalenani aagnaapinchenu.
kaabatti aa daasudu athani yeduta saagilapadi mrokki naayedala orchukonumu, neeku anthayu chellinthunani cheppagaa
aa daasuni yajamaanudu kanikara padi, vaanini vidichipetti, vaani appu kshaminchenu.
ayithe aa daasudu bayataku velli thanaku nooru dhenaaramulu achiyunna thana thoodidaasulalo okaninichuchi, vaani gonthupattukonineevu achiyunnadhi chellimpu manenu
anduku vaani thoodidaasudu saagilapadinaa yedala orchukonumu, neeku chellinchedhanani vaanini vedu konenu gaani
vaadu oppukonaka achiyunnadhi chellinchuvaraku vaanini cherasaalalo veyinchenu.
kaagaa vaani thoodi daasulu jariginadhi chuchi, mikkili duḥkhapadi, vachi, jariginadanthayu thama yajamaanuniki vivaramugaa telipiri.
appudu vaani yajamaanudu vaanini pilipinchichedda daasudaa, neevu nannu vedukontivi ganuka nee appanthayu kshaminchithini;
nenu ninnu karuninchina prakaaramu neevunu nee thoodidaasuni karunimpavalasi yundenu gadaa ani vaanithoo cheppenu.
anduchetha vaani yajamaanudu kopapadi, thanaku achiyunnadanthayu chellinchu varaku baadha parachuvaariki vaani nappaginchenu.
meelo prathivaadunu thana sahodaruni hrudayapoorvakamugaa kshamimpaniyedala naa paralokapu thandriyu aa prakaarame meeyedala cheyunanenu.
yesu ee maatalucheppi chaalinchina tharuvaatha galilayanundi yordaanu addarinunna yoodaya praantha mulaku vacchenu.
bahu janasamoohamulu aayananu vembadimpagaa, aayana vaarini akkada svasthaparachenu.
parisayyulu aayananu shodhimpavalenani aayanayoddhaku vachi'e hethuvuchethanainanu purushudu thana bhaaryanu vidanaaduta nyaayamaa? Ani adugagaa
aayana srujinchina vaadu aadhinundi vaarini purushunigaanu streeni gaanu srujinchenaniyu
indu nimitthamu purushudu thalidandrulanu vidichi thana bhaaryanu hatthukonunu, vaariddarunu ekashareeramugaa undurani cheppenaniyu meeru chaduvaledaa?
kaabatti vaarikanu iddarukaaka ekashareeramugaa unnaaru ganuka dhevudu jathaparachinavaarini manushyudu veruparacha koodadani cheppenu.
anduku vaaru aalaagaithe parityaaga patrikanichi aamenu vidanaadumani moshe yenduku aagnaapinchenani vaaraayananu adugagaa
aayanamee hrudayakaathinyamunu batti mee bhaaryalanu vidanaada moshe selavicchenu, gaani aadhinundi aalaagu jarugaledu.

mariyu vyabhichaaramu nimitthame thappa thana bhaaryanu vidanaadi mariyokatenu pendlichesikonuvaadu vyabhichaaramu cheyuchunnaa daniyu, vidanaadabadinadaanini pendlichesikonuvaadu vyabhichaaramu cheyuchunnaadaniyu meethoo cheppu chunnaanani vaarithoonanenu.
aayana shishyulubhaaryaabharthalakundu sambandhamu ittidaithe pendli chesikonuta yukthamu kaadani aayanathoo cheppiri.
andu kaayana anugrahamu nondinavaaru thappa mari evarunu ee maatanu angeekarimpaneraru.
