thalli garbhamunundi napunsakulugaa puttinavaaru galaru, manushyulavalana napunsakulugaa cheyabadina napunsakulunu galaru, paraloka raajyamunimitthamu thammunu thaame napunsakulanugaa chesi konina napunsakulunu galaru. (ee maatanu) angeekarimpa galavaadu angeekarinchunu gaaka ani vaarithoo cheppenu.
appudu aayana vaarimeeda chethulunchi praarthana cheyavalenani kondaru chinnapillalanu aayanayoddhaku theesikoni vachiri.
aayana shishyulu, theesikonivachina vaarini gaddimpagaa yesu chinnapillalanu atankaparachaka vaarini naa yoddhaku raaniyyudi; paralokaraajyamu eelaativaaridani vaarithoo cheppi
vaarimeeda chethulunchi, akkadanunchi lechipoyenu.
idigo okadu aayanayoddhaku vachibodhakudaa, nityajeevamu pondutaku nenu e manchi kaaryamu cheya valenani aayananu adigenu.
andukaayana manchi kaaryamunugoorchi nannenduku aduguchunnaavu? Manchi vaadokkade. neevu jeevamulo praveshimpagorinayedala aagnalanu gaikonumani cheppenu. Athadu e aagnalani aayananu adugagaa
yesu narahatya cheyavaddu, vyabhicharimpa vaddu, dongilavaddu, abaddha saakshyamu palukavaddu, thalidandru lanu sanmaanimpumu,
ninnuvale nee poruguvaanini premimpavalenu anunaviye ani cheppenu.
anduku aa ¸yauvanudu ivanniyu anusarinchuchune yunnaanu; ikanu naaku koduva emani aayananu adigenu.
anduku yesu–neevu paripoornudavagutaku korinayedala, poyi nee aasthini ammi beedalakimmu, appudu paralokamandu neeku dhanamu kalugunu; neevu vachi nannu vembadinchumani athanithoo cheppenu.
ayithe aa ¸yauvanudu migula aasthigalavaadu ganuka aa maata vini vyasanapaduchu velli poyenu.
yesu thana shishyulanu chuchi dhanavanthudu paraloka raajyamulo praveshinchuta durlabhamani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
idigaaka dhanavanthudu paraloka raajyamulo praveshinchutakante soodibejjamulo onte dooruta sulabhamani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
shishyulu ee maata vini mikkili aashcharyapadi'aalaagaithe evadu rakshanapondagaladani adugagaa
yesu vaarini chuchi'idi manushyulaku asaadhyame gaani dhevuniki samasthamunu saadhyamani cheppenu.
pethuru'idigo memu samasthamunu vidichipetti ninnu vembadinchithivi ganuka maakemi dorakunani aayananu adugagaa

yesu vaarithoo itlanenu(prapancha) punarjananamandu manushya kumaarudu thana mahimagala sinhaasanamumeeda aaseenudai yundunapudu nannu vembadinchina meerunu pandrendu sinhaasanamulameeda aaseenulai ishraayelu pandrendu gotramulavaariki theerputheerchuduru.

naa naamamu nimitthamu annadammulanainanu akka chellendranainanu thandrinainanu thalli nainanu pillalanainanu bhoomulanainanu indlanainanu vidichipettina prathivaadunu nooruretlu pondunu; idigaaka nitya jeevamunu svathantrinchukonunu.
modativaaru anekulu kadapativaaraguduru, kadapativaaru modativaaragu duru.
elaaganagaa paralokaraajyamu oka inti yajamaanuni poliyunnadhi. Athadu thana draakshathootalo pani vaarini kooliki pettukonutaku prodduna bayaludheri
dinamunaku oka dhenaaramu choppuna panivaarithoo odabadi, thana draakshathootaloniki vaarini pampenu.

tharuvaatha athadu daadaapu tommidi gantalaku velli santha veedhilo ooraka nilichiyunna marikondarini chuchi meerunu naa draakshathootaloniki velludi, yemi nyaayamo adhi meekitthunani vaarithoo cheppagaa vaarunu velliri.
meerunu naa draakshathootaloniki velludi, yemi nyaayamo adhi meekitthunani vaarithoo cheppagaa vaarunu velliri.
daadaapu pandrendu gantalakunu, moodu gantalakunu, athadu marala velli, aalaage chesenu.
thirigi daadaapu ayidu ganta laku velli, marikondaru nilichiyundagaa chuchi'ikkada dinamanthayu meerenduku oorakane nilichiyunnaarani vaarini adugagaa
vaaru evadunu mammunu kooliki pettukona ledaniri. Andukathadu meerunu naa draakshathootaloniki velludanenu.
saayankaalamainappudu aa draakshathoota yajamaanudu thana gruhanirvaahakuni chuchi panivaarini pilichi, chivara vachinavaaru modalukoni modata vachina vaarivaraku vaariki kooli immani cheppenu.
daadaapu ayidu gantalaku kooliki kudirinavaaru vachi okkoka dhenaaramuchoppuna theesikoniri.
modati vaaru vachi thamaku ekkuva dorakunanukoniri gaani vaarikini okkoka dhenaaramuchoppunane dorakenu.
vaaradhi theesikoni chivara vachina veeru okkaganta maatrame panichesinanu,
pagalanthayu kashtapadi yendabaadha sahinchina maathoo vaarini samaanamu chesithive ani aa yinti yaja maanunimeeda sanugukoniri.
andukathadu vaarilo okani chuchisnehithudaa, nenu neeku anyaayamu cheyaledhe; neevu naayoddha oka dhenaaramunaku odabadaledaa? nee sommu neevu theesikoni pommu;
nee kichinatte kadapata vachina veerikichutakunu naakishtamainadhi;
naakishtamuvachi nattu naa sontha sommuthoo cheyuta nyaayamu kaadaa? Nenu manchivaadanainanduna neeku kadupumantagaa unnadaa ani cheppenu.
ee prakaarame kadapativaaru modati vaaraguduru, modativaaru kadapativaaraguduru.
yesu yerooshalemunaku vellanaiyunnappudu aayana pandrendumandi shishyulanu ekaanthamugaa theesikonipoyi, maargamandu vaarithoo itlanenu.
idigo yerooshalemunaku velluchunnaamu; akkada manushyakumaarudu pradhaanayaajakulakunu shaastrulakunu appagimpabadunu; vaaraayanaku maranashiksha vidhinchi
aayananu apahasinchu takunu koradaalathoo kottutakunu siluvaveyutakunu anyajanulaku aayananu appaginthuru; moodava dinamuna aayana marala lechunu.
appudu jebedayi kumaarula thalli thana kumaarulathoo aayanayoddhaku vachi namaskaaramuchesi yoka manavi cheyabogaa
neevemi koruchunnaavani aayana adigenu. Andukaame nee raajyamandu ee naa yiddaru kumaarulalo okadu nee kudivaipunanu okadu nee yedamavaipunanu koorchunda selavimmani aayanathoo anenu.
anduku yesu meeremi aduguchunnaaro adhi meeku teliyadu; nenu traagabovu ginnelonidi meeru traaga galaraa? Ani adugagaa vaaru traagagalamaniri.
aayanameeru naa ginnelonidi traaguduru gaani naa kudivaipunanu naa yedamavaipunanu koorchundanichuta naa vashamunaledu; naa thandrichetha evariki siddhaparachabadeno vaarike adhi dorakunani cheppenu.
thakkina padhimandi shishyulu ee maata vini aa yiddaru sahodarulameeda kopapadiri
ganuka yesu thanayoddhaku vaarini pilichi anyajanulalo adhikaarulu vaarimeeda prabhutvamu cheyuduraniyu, vaarilo goppavaaru vaarimeeda adhikaaramu cheyuduraniyu meeku teliyunu.
meelo aalaagunda koodadu; meelo evadu goppavaadai yundagoruno vaadu mee parichaarakudai yundavalenu;
meelo evadu mukhyudai yundagoruno vaadu mee daasudai yunda valenu.
aalaage manushyakumaarudu parichaaramu cheyinchu konutaku raaledu gaani parichaaramu cheyutakunu anekulaku prathigaa vimochana krayadhanamugaa thana praanamu nichutakunu vacchenani cheppenu.
vaaru yerikonundi velluchundagaa bahu janasamoo hamu aayanaventa vellenu.
idigo trovaprakkanu koorchunna yiddaru gruddivaaru yesu aa maargamuna velluchunnaadani viniprabhuvaa, daaveedu kumaarudaa, mammu karunimpumani kekaluvesiri.
oorakundudani janulu vaarini gaddinchiri gaani vaaru prabhuvaa, daaveedu kumaarudaa, mammu karunimpumani mari biggaragaa kekavesiri.
yesu nilichi vaarini pilichi nenu meekemi cheyagoruchunnaarani adugagaa
vaaruprabhuvaa, maa kannulu teravavalenaniri.
kaabatti yesu kanikarapadi vaari kannulu muttenu; ventane vaaru drushtipondi aayana venta velliri.
tharuvaatha yerooshalemunaku sameepinchi oleevachetla kondadaggara unna betpageku vachinappudu yesu thana shishyulalo iddarini chuchi
mee yedutanunna graamamunaku velludi; vellagaane kattabadiyunna yoka gaadi dayu daanithoonunna yoka gaadidapillayu meeku kana badunu. Vaatini vippi naayoddhaku thoolukoni randi;
evadainanu meethoo emainanu anina yedala'avi prabhuvu naku kaavalasiyunnavani cheppavalenu, ventane athadu vaatini thooli pettunani cheppi vaarini pampenu.
pravakthavalana cheppabadinadhi neraverunatlu idi jarigenu, adhe managaa
idigo nee raaju saatvikudai, gaadidhanu bhaaravaahaka pashuvupillayaina chinna gaadidhanu ekkineeyoddhaku vachuchunnaadani seeyonu kumaarithoo cheppudi anunadhi.
shishyulu velli yesu thamakaagnaapinchina prakaaramu chesi
aa gaadidhanu daani pillanu thoolukoni vachi vaatimeeda thama battalu veyagaa aayana battalameeda koorchundenu.
janasamoohamulonu anekulu thama battalu daaripoduguna parachiri; kondaru chetlakommalu nariki daaripoduguna parachiri.

janasamoohamulalo aayanaku mundu velluchundinavaarunu venuka vachuchundina vaarunu daaveedu kumaaruniki jayamu prabhuvu perata vachuvaadu sthuthimpabadunugaaka sarvonnathamaina sthalamulalo jayamu ani kekalu veyuchundiri.
aayana yerooshalemu loniki vachinappudu pattanamanthayu'eeyana evaro ani kalavarapadenu.
janasamoohamu eeyana galilayaloni najarethuvaadagu pravakthayaina yesu ani cheppiri.
yesu dhevaalayamulo praveshinchi krayavikrayamulu cheyuvaarinandarini vellagotti, rookalu maarchuvaari ballalanu guvvalammuvaari peethamulanu padadrosi
naa mandiramu praarthana mandiramanabadunu ani vraayabadiyunnadhi, ayithe meeru daanini dongala guhagaa chesedivaaranenu.
gruddivaarunu kuntivaarunu dhevaalayamulo aayana yoddhaku raagaa aayana vaarini svasthaparachenu.
kaagaa pradhaanayaajakulunu shaastrulunu aayana chesina vinthalanu, daaveedu kumaaruniki jayamu ani dhevaalayamulo kekalu veyuchunna chinnapillalanu chuchi kopamuthoo mandipadi

veeru cheppuchunnadhi vinuchunnaavaa? Ani aayananu adigiri. Anduku yesu vinuchunnaanu; baalurayokkayu chantipillalayokkayu notasthootramu siddhimpajesithivi anu maata meerennadunu chaduvaledaa? Ani vaarithoo cheppi
vaarini vidichi pattanamunundi bayaludheri bethani yaku velli akkada basachesenu.
udayamandu pattanamunaku marala velluchundagaa aayana aakaligonenu.

appudu trovaprakkanu unna yoka anjoorapuchettunu chuchi, daaniyoddhaku raagaa, daaniyandu aakulu thappa maremiyu kanabadaledu ganuka daanini chuchi–ikameedata ennatikini neevu kaapu kaaya kunduvugaaka ani cheppenu; thakshaname aa anjoorapuchettu endipoyenu.
shishyuladhichuchi aashcharyapadi'anjoorapu chettu entha tvaragaa endipoyenani cheppukoniri.

anduku yesu–meeru vishvaasamugaligi sandhehapadakundinayedala, ee anjoorapuchettunaku jarigina daanini cheyuta maatrame kaadu, ee kondanu chuchi neevu etthabadi samudramulo padaveyabaduduvu gaakani cheppinayedala, aalaagu jarugunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
mariyu meeru praarthanacheyunappudu vetini aduguduro avi (dorakinavani) namminayedala meeru vaatinannitini pondudurani vaarithoo cheppenu.

aayana dhevaalayamuloniki vachi bodhinchu chundagaa pradhaanayaajakulunu prajala peddalunu aayanayoddhaku vachi'e adhikaaramuvalana neevu ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaavu? ee adhikaaramevadu neekicchenani adugagaa
yesu nenunu mimmu noka maata adugudunu; adhi meeru naathoo cheppinayedala, nenunu e adhikaaramuvalana ee kaaryamulu cheyuchunnaano adhi meethoo cheppudunu.

yohaanu ichina baapthismamu ekkadanundi kaliginadhi? Paralokamunundi kaliginadaa, manushyulanundi kaliginadaa? Ani vaarinadigenu. Vaarumanamu paraloka munundi ani cheppithimaa, aayana'aalaagaithe meerenduku athani nammaledani manalanadugunu;
manushyulavalananani cheppithimaa, janulaku bhayapaduchunnaamu; andaru yohaanunu pravaktha ani yenchuchunnaarani thamalo thaamu aalochinchukoni maaku teliyadani yesunaku uttharamichiri
andukaayana'e adhikaaramuvalana ee kaaryamulu nenu cheyuchunnaano adhiyu meethoo cheppanu.
meekemi thoochuchunnadhi? Oka manushyuniki iddaru kumaarulundiri. Athadu modativaaniyoddhaku vachikumaarudaa, nedu poyi draakshathootalo pani cheyumani cheppagaa
vaaduponu ani yuttharamicchenu gaani pimmata manassu maarchukoni poyenu.
athadu rendavavaaniyoddhaku vachi aa prakaarame cheppagaa vaadu'ayyaa, podunanenu gaani poledu. ee yiddarilo evadu thandri yishtaprakaaramu chesinavaadani vaari nadigenu.
anduku vaarumodativaade aniri. Yesusunkarulunu veshyalunu meekante mundhugaa dhevuni raajyamulo praveshinchudurani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
yohaanu neethi maargamuna meeyoddhaku vacchenu, meerathanini nammaledu; ayithe sunkarulunu veshya lunu athanini nammiri; meeru adhi chuchiyu athanini nammu natlu pashchaatthaapapadaka pothiri.

mariyoka upamaanamu vinudi. Inti yajamaanu dokadundenu. Athadu draakshathoota naatinchi, daani chuttu kanche veyinchi, andulo draakshalatotti toli pinchi, gopuramu kattinchi, kaapulaku daani gutthakichi, dheshaantharamu poyenu.
pandlakaalamu sameepinchinappudu pandlalo thana bhaagamu theesikoni vachutaku aa kaapula yoddhaku thana daasulanampagaa
aa kaapulu athani daasulanu pattukoni, yokani kottiri yokani champiri, mari yokanimeeda raallu ruvviri.
marala athadu munupati kante ekkuvamandi ithara daasulanu pampagaa vaaru veerini aa prakaarame chesiri.
thudaku naa kumaaruni sanmaaninchedharanukoni thana kumaaruni vaari yoddhaku pampenu.
ayinanu aa kaapulu kumaaruni chuchi ithadu vaarasudu; ithanini champi ithani svaasthyamu theesikondamurandani thamalo thaamu cheppukoni
athani pattukoni draakshathoota velupata padavesi champiri.
kaabatti aa draakshathoota yajamaanudu vachinappudu aa kaapula nemi cheyunanenu.
anduku vaaru'aa durmaargulanu kathina mugaa sanharinchi, vaativaati kaalamulayandu thanaku pandlanu chellinchunatti itharakaapulaku aa draakshathoota gutthakichunani aayanathoo cheppiri.

mariyu yesu vaarini chuchi illu kattuvaaru nishedhinchina raayi moolaku thalaraayi aayenu. Idi prabhuvuvalanane kaligenu. Idi mana kannulaku aashcharyamu anu maata meeru lekhanamulalo ennadunu chaduvaledaa?
kaabatti dhevuni raajyamu mee yoddhanundi tola gimpabadi, daani phalamichu janulakiyyabadunani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
mariyu ee raathimeeda paduvaadu thunakalaipovunu gaani adhi evanimeeda paduno vaanini nali cheyunanenu.
pradhaanayaajakulunu parisayyulunu aayana cheppina upamaanamulanu vini, thammunu goorchiye cheppenani grahinchi
aayananu pattukona samayamu choochuchundiri gaani janulandaru aayananu pravakthayani yenchiri ganuka vaariki bhayapadiri.
yesu vaarikuttharamichuchu thirigi upamaana reethigaa itlanenu.
paralokaraajyamu, thana kumaaruniki pendli vinduchesina yoka raajunu poliyunnadhi.
aa pendli vinduku piluvabadina vaarini rappinchutaku athadu thanadaasu lanu pampinappudu vaaru raanollaka poyiri.

kaagaa athadu idigo naa vindu siddhaparachiyunnaanu; eddu lunu krovvina pashuvulunu vadhimpabadinavi; anthayu siddha mugaa unnadhi; pendli vinduku randani piluvabadina vaarithoo cheppudani vere daasulanu pampenu gaani
vaaru lakshyamu cheyaka, okadu thana polamunakunu mariyokadu thana varthakamunakunu velliri.
thakkinavaaru athani daasulanu pattukoni avamaanaparachi champiri.
kaabatti raaju kopapadi thana dandlanu pampi, aa narahanthakulanu sanharinchi, vaari pattanamu thagalabettinchenu.
appudathadu pendli vindu siddhamugaa unnadhi gaani piluvabadinavaaru paatrulu kaaru.
ganuka raajamaargamulaku poyi meeku kanabadu vaarinandarini pendli vinduku piluvudani thana daasulathoo cheppenu.
aa daasulu raajamaargamulaku poyi chedda vaarinemi manchivaarinemi thamaku kanabadinavaari nandarini poguchesiri ganuka vinduku vachinavaarithoo aa pendli shaala nindenu.
raaju koorchunna vaarini chooda lopaliki vachi, akkada pendlivastramu dharinchukonani yokani chuchi
snehithudaa,pendli vastramuleka ikkadi kelaagu vachithi vani adugagaa vaadu mauniyai yundenu.
anthata raaju veeni kaallu chethulu katti velupati chikatiloniki trosiveyudi; akkada edpunu pandlu korukutayu undunani parichaarakulathoo cheppenu.
kaagaa piluvabadina vaaru anekulu, erparachabadinavaaru kondare ani cheppenu.
appudu parisayyulu velli, maatalalo aayananu chikkuparachavalenani aalochanacheyuchu
bodhakudaa,neevu satyavanthudavai yundi, dhevuni maargamu satyamugaa bodhinchuchunnaavaniyu, neevu evanini lakshyapettavaniyu, momaatamu lenivaadavaniyu erugudumu.
neekemi thoochuchunnadhi? Kaisaruku pannichuta nyaayamaa? Kaadaa? Maathoo cheppumani adugutaku herodeeyulathoo kooda thama shishyulanu aayanayoddhaku pampiri.
yesu vaari chedu thana merigi veshadhaarulaaraa, nannenduku shodhinchu chunnaaru?
pannurooka yokati naaku choopudani vaarithoo cheppagaa vaaraayanayoddhaku oka dhenaaramu techiri.
appudaayana ee roopamunu paivraathayu evarivani vaarinadugagaa vaarukaisaruvaniri.
andukaayana aalaagaithe kaisaruvi kaisarunakunu, dhevunivi dhevunikini chellinchu dani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaareemaata vini aashcharyapadi aayananu vidichi velli poyiri.
punarut'thaanamuledani cheppedi saddookayyulu aa dinamuna aayanayoddhaku vachi
bodhakudaa, okadu pillalu leka chanipoyinayedala athani sahodarudu athani bhaaryanu pendlichesikoni thana sahodaruniki santhaanamu kalugajeya valenani moshe cheppenu;
maalo eduguru sahodarulundiri; modativaadu pendlichesikoni chanipoyenu; athaniki santhaanamu lenanduna athani sahodarudu athani bhaaryanu theesikonenu.
rendava vaadunu moodava vaadunu edava vaanivaraku andarunu aalaage jariginchi chanipoyiri.
andari venuka aa streeyu chanipoyenu.
punarut'thaana mandu ee yedugurilo aame evaniki bhaaryagaa undunu? aame veerandarikini bhaaryagaa undenu gadaa ani aayananu adigiri.
anduku yesulekhanamulanugaani dhevuni shakthinigaani erugaka meeru porabaduchunnaaru.
punarut'thaanamandu evarunu pendlichesikonaru, pendli kiyya badaru; vaaru paralokamandunna doothalavale unduru.
mruthula punarut'thaanamunugoorchinenu abraahaamu dhevu danu, issaaku dhevudanu, yaakobu dhevudanai yunnaanani dhevudu meethoo cheppinamaata meeru chaduvaledaa?
aayana sajeevulake dhevudu gaani mruthulaku dhevudu kaadani vaarithoo cheppenu.
januladhi vini aayana bodha kaashcharyapadiri.
aayana saddookayyula noru mooyinchenani pari sayyulu vini koodivachiri.
vaarilo oka dharmashaastro padheshakudu aayananu shodhinchuchu
bodhakudaa, dharma shaastramulo mukhyamaina aagna edani adigenu.
andu kaayananee poornahrudayamuthoonu nee poornaatmathoonu nee poornamanassuthoonu nee dhevudaina prabhuvunu premimpa valenanunadhiye.
idi mukhya mainadhiyu modatidiyunaina aagna.
ninnuvale nee poruguvaani premimpavalenanu rendava aagnayu daanivantidhe.
ee rendu aagnalu dharma shaastramanthatikini pravakthalakunu aadhaaramai yunnavani athanithoo cheppenu.
okappudu parisayyulu koodiyundagaa yesu vaarini chuchi
kreesthunugoorchi meekemi thoochuchunnadhi? aayana evani kumaarudani adigenu. Vaaru aayana daaveedu kumaarudani cheppiri.
andukaayana'aalaa gaithe nenu nee shatruvulanu nee paadamula krinda unchuvaraku
neevu naa kudipaarshvamuna koorchundumani prabhuvunaa prabhuvuthoo cheppenu ani daaveedu aayananu prabhuvani aatmavalana ela cheppu chunnaadu?
daaveedu aayananu prabhuvani cheppinayedala, aayana elaagu athaniki kumaarudagunani vaarinadugagaa
evadunu maarumaata cheppalekapoyenu. Mariyu aa dinamunundi evadunu aayananu oka prashnayu aduga tegimpaledu.
appudu yesu janasamoohamulathoonu thana shishyulathoonu itlanenu
shaastrulunu parisayyulunu moshe peethamandu koorchunduvaaru
ganuka vaaru meethoo cheppuvaati nannitini anusarinchigai konudi, ayinanu vaari kriyalachoppuna cheyakudi; vaaru cheppudure gaani cheyaru.
moya shakyamukaani bhaaramaina baruvulu katti manushyula bhujamulameeda vaaru pettuduregaani thama vrelithoonaina vaatini kadalimpanollaru.
manushyulaku kanabadunimitthamu thama panulanniyu cheyuduru; thama raksharekulu vedalpugaanu thama chengulu peddavigaanu cheyuduru;
vindulalo agrasthaanamulanu samaaja mandiramulalo agrapeethamulanu
santha veedhulalo vandhana mulanu manushyulachetha bodhakulani piluvabadutayu koruduru.
meeraithe bodhakulani piluvabadavaddu, okkade mee bodhakudu, meerandaru sahodarulu.
mariyu bhoomimeeda evanikainanu thandri ani perupettavaddu; okkade mee thandri; aayana paralokamandunnaadu.
mariyu meeru guruvulani piluvabadavaddu; kreesthu'okkade mee guruvu.
meelo andarikante goppavaadu meeku parichaarakudai yundavalenu.
thannuthaanu hechinchu konuvaadu thaggimpabadunu; thannuthaanu thagginchukonuvaadu hechimpabadunu.
ayyo, veshadhaarulaina shaastrulaaraa, parisayyu laaraa, meeru manushyulayeduta paralokaraajyamunu mooyuduru;
meerandulo praveshimparu, praveshinchu vaarini praveshimpaniyyaru.

ayyo, veshadhaarulaina shaastrulaaraa, parisayyulaaraa, okani mee mathamulo kalupukonutaku meeru samudra munu bhoomini chuttivacchedaru; athadu kalisinappudu athani meekante rendanthalu naraka patrunigaa cheyuduru
ayyo, andhulaina maargadarshakulaaraa, okadu dhevaalayamuthoodani ottupettukonte andulo emiyu ledu gaani dhevaalayamuloni bangaaramuthoodani ottu pettukonte vaadu daaniki baddhudani meeru cheppuduru.
avivekulaaraa, andhulaaraa, edi goppadhi? Bangaaramaa, bangaaramunu parishuddhaparachu dhevaalayamaa?
mariyubalipeethamuthoodani yokadu ottupettukonte, andulo emiyu ledu gaani, daani painundu arpanamuthoodani ottupettukonte daaniki baddhudani meeru cheppuduru.
avivekulaaraa, andhulaaraa, edi goppadhi? Arpanamaa, arpanamunu parishuddhaparachu balipeethamaa?
balipeethamuthoodani ottupettu konuvaadu, daani thoodaniyu daani painundu vaatannitithoodaniyu ottupettukonuchunnaadu.
mariyu dhevaalayamu thoodani ottupettukonuvaadu, daani thoodaniyu andulo nivasinchuvaani thoodaniyu ottupettukonuchunnaadu.
mariyu aakaashamuthoodani ottupettukonuvaadu dhevuni sinhaasanamu thoodaniyu daanipaini koorchunnavaani thoodaniyu ottupettukonu chunnaadu.

ayyo, veshadhaarulaina shaastrulaaraa, parisayyulaaraa, meeru pudeenaalonu sopulonu jeelakarralonu padhiyava vanthu chellinchi, dharmashaastramulo pradhaanamaina vishayamulanu, anagaa nyaayamunu kanikaramunu vishvaasamunu vidichipettithiri; vaatini maanaka veetini cheyavalasi yundenu.
andhulaina maargadarshakulaaraa, domalekundu natlu vadiyagatti ontenu minguvaaru meere.
ayyo, veshadhaarulaina shaastrulaaraa, parisayyu laaraa, meeru ginneyu pallemunu velupata shuddhicheyu duru gaani avi lopala doputhoonu ajithendriyatvamu thoonu nindiyunnavi.
gruddiparisayyudaa, ginneyu pallemunu velupala shuddhiyagunattugaa mundu vaatilopala shuddhicheyumu.

ayyo, veshadhaarulaina shaastrulaaraa, parisayyulaaraa, meeru sunnamukottina samaadhulanu poli yunnaaru. Avi velupala shrungaaramugaa agapadunu gaani lopala chachinavaari yemukalathoonu samastha kalmashamuthoonu nindiyunnavi.
aalaage meeru velupala manushyu laku neethimanthulugaa nagapaduchunnaaru gaani, lopala veshadhaaranathoonu akramamuthoonu nindi yunnaaru.
ayyo, veshadhaarulaina shaastrulaaraa, parisayyulaaraa, meeru pravakthala samaadhulanu kattinchuchu, neethi manthula goreelanu shrungaarinchuchu
manamu mana pitharula dinamulalo undinayedala pravakthala marana vishayamulo vaarithoo paalivaaramai yundaka podumani cheppukonduru.
anduvalanane meeru pravakthalanu champinavaari kumaarulai yunnaarani mee meeda meere saakshyamu cheppukonuchunnaaru.
meerunu mee pitharula parimaanamu poorthi cheyudi.
sarpamulaaraa, sarpasanthaanamaa, narakashikshanu mee relaagu thappinchukonduru?

anduchetha idigo nenu mee yoddhaku pravakthalanu gnaanulanu shaastrulanu pampuchunnaanu; meeru vaarilo kondarini champi siluvaveyuduru, kondarini mee samaajamandiramulalo koradaalato kotti, pattanamunundi pattanamunaku tharumuduru.

neethimanthu daina hebelu rakthamu modalukoni balipeethamunakunu, dhevaa layamunakunu madhya meeru champina barakeeya kumaarudagu jekaryaa rakthamuvaraku bhoomimeeda chindimpabadina neethi manthula rakthamanthayu mee meediki vachunu.
ivanniyu ee tharamuvaarimeediki vachunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.

yerooshalemaa, yerooshalemaa, pravakthalanu champuchunu neeyoddhaku pampabadinavaarini raallathoo kottuchunu undu daanaa, kodi thana pillalanu rekkalakrindi kelaagu cherchu konuno aalaage nenunu nee pillalanu ennomaarulu cherchu konavalenani yuntini gaani meeru ollakapothiri.
idigo mee yillu meeku viduvabadiyunnadhi
idimodalukoni prabhuvu perata vachuvaadu sthuthimpabadugaakani meeru cheppu varaku nannu choodarani meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
yesu dhevaalayamunundi bayaludheri velluchundagaa aayana shishyulu aa dhevaalayapu kattadamulu aayanaku choopimpavachiri.
andukaayana meeru ivanniyu choochuchunnaaru gadaa; raathimeeda raayi yokatiyainanu ikkada nilichiyundakunda padadroyabadunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo anenu.
aayana oleevala kondameeda koorchundiyunnappudu shishyulaayanayoddhaku ekaanthamugaa vachi ivi eppudu jarugunu? nee raakadakunu ee yugasamaapthikini soochanalevi? Maathoo cheppumanagaa
yesu vaarithoo itlanenu evadunu mimmunu mosaparachakunda choochukonudi.
anekulu naa perata vachi nene kreesthunani cheppi paluvurini mosa parachedaru.
mariyu meeru yuddhamulanu goorchiyu yuddha samaachaaramulanu goorchiyu vinaboduru; meeru kalavarapadakunda choochukonudi. Ivi jarugavalasiyunnavi gaani anthamu ventane raadu.
janamumeediki janamunu raajyamumeediki raajyamunu lechunu.
akkadakkada karavulunu bhookampamulunu kalugunu; ivanniyu vedhana laku praarambhamu.
appudu janulu mimmunu shramala paaluchesi champedaru; meeru naa naamamu nimitthamu sakala janamulachetha dveshimpabaduduru.
anekulu abhyantharapadi, yokaninokadu appaginchi yokaninokadu dveshinthuru.
anekulaina abaddha pravakthalu vachi paluvurini mosaparachedaru;
akramamu vistharinchutachetha anekula prema challaarunu.
anthamuvaraku sahinchinavaa devado vaade rakshimpabadunu.
mariyu ee raajya suvaartha sakala janamulaku saakshyaarthamai lokamandanthatanu prakatimpabadunu; atutharuvaatha anthamu vachunu.
kaabatti pravakthayaina daaniyeludvaaraa cheppabadina naashanakaramaina heyavasthuvu parishuddhasthalamandu niluchuta meeru choodagaane chaduvuvaadu grahinchugaaka
yoodayalo unduvaaru kondalaku paaripovalenu
middemeeda unduvaadu thana yintilonundi edainanu theesikoni povutaku digakoodadu;
polamulo undu vaadu, thana battalu theesikoni povutaku intiki raakoodadu.
ayyo, aa dinamulalo garbhinulakunu paalichuvaarikini shrama.
appudu mahaa shrama kalugunu ganuka meeru paaripovuta chalikaalamandainanu vishraanthidinamandainanu sambhavimpakundavalenani praarthinchudi.
lokaarambhamu nundi ippativarakunu atti shrama kalugaledu, ika eppu dunu kalugabodu.
aa dinamulu thakkuva cheyabadaka poyina yedala e shareeriyu thappinchukonadu. erparacha badinavaari nimitthamu aa dinamulu thakkuva cheyabadunu.
aa kaalamandu evadainanu'idigo kreesthu ikkada unnaadu, akkada unnaadu ani cheppinayedala namma kudi.
abaddhapu kreesthulunu abaddhapu pravakthalunu vachi, saadhyamaithe erparachabadina vaarini sahithamu mosaparachutakai goppa soochaka kriyalanu mahatkaaryamulanu kanabarachedaru.
idigo mundhugaa nenu meethoo cheppiyunnaanu.
kaabatti evarainanu'idigo aranyamulo unnaadani meethoo cheppinanu vellakudi idigo lopali gadhilo unnaadani cheppinanu nammakudi
merupu thoorpuna putti padamativaraku elaagu kanabaduno aalaage manushyakumaaruni raakadayu nundunu.
peenugu ekkada unnado akkada gaddalu pogavunu.
aa dinamula shrama mugisina ventane chikati sooryuni kammunu, chandrudu kaanthini iyyadu, aakaashamunundi nakshatramulu raalunu, aakaashamandali shakthulu kadalimpa badunu.

appudu manushyakumaaruni soochana aakaashamandu kanabadunu. Appudu manushyakumaarudu prabhaavamuthoonu mahaa mahimathoonu aakaasha meghaaroodhudai vachuta chuchi, bhoomimeedanunna sakala gotramulavaaru rommu kottukonduru.
mariyu aayana goppaboorathoo thana doothalanu pampunu. Vaaru aakaashamu yokka ee chivaranundi aa chivaravaraku naludikkulanundi aayana erparachukoninavaarini poguchethuru.
anjoorapu chettunu chuchi oka upamaanamu nerchu konudi. Anjoorapukomma lethadai chigirinchunappudu vasantha kaalamu yinka sameepamugaa unnadani meeku teliyunu.
aa prakaarame meeree sangathulanniyu jaruguta choochunappudu aayana sameepamunane, dvaaramudaggarane yunnaa dani telisikonudi.
ivanniyu jaruguvaraku ee tharamu gathimpadani nishchayamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanu.
aakaashamunu bhoomiyu gathinchunu gaani naa maatalu'e maatramunu gathimpavu.
ayithe aa dinamunu goorchiyu aa gadiyanugoorchiyu thandri maatrame (yerugunu) gaani, ye manushyudainanu paralokamandali doothalai nanu kumaarudainanu erugaru.
novahu dinamulu elaagundeno manushyakumaaruni raakadayunu aalaage undunu.
jalapralayamunaku mundati dinamulalo novahu odaloniki vellina dinamuvaraku, vaaru thinuchu traaguchu pendlichesikonuchu pendlikichuchunundi
jalapralayamuvachi andarini kottukonipovu varaku erugaka poyiri; aalaagunane manushyakumaaruni raakada undunu.
aa kaalamuna iddaru polamulo unduru, okadu theesi konipobadunu okadu vidichi pettabadunu.
iddaru streelu thirugali visaruchunduru, okate theesikoni pobadunu,okate vidichipettabadunu.
kaavuna e dinamuna mee prabhuvu vachuno meeku teliyadu ganuka melakuvagaa nundudi.
e jaamuna dongavachuno yinti yajamaanuniki telisiyundina yedala athadu melakuvagaa undi thana yintiki kannamu veyaniyyadani meereruguduru.
meeranukonani gadiyalo manushyakumaarudu vachunu ganukane meerunu siddhamugaa undudi.
yajamaanudu thana yintivaariki thaginavela annamu pettutaku vaaripaina unchina nammakamainavaadunu buddhimanthudunaina daasudevadu?
yajamaanudu vachinappudu e daasudu eelaagu cheyuchunduta athadu kanugonuno aa daasudu dhanyudu.
athadu thana yaavadaasthimeeda vaani nunchunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanu.
ayithe dushtudaina yoka daasudu naa yajamaanudu aalasyamu cheyuchunnaadani thana manassulo anukoni
thanathoodi daasulanu kotta modalupetti, traagubothulathoo thinuchu traaguchununte
aa daasudu kanipettani dinamulonu vaadanukonani gadiyalonu vaani yajamaanudu vachi,vaanini narikinchi veshadhaarulathoo kooda vaaniki paalu niyaminchunu.
akkada edpunu pandlu korukutayu nundunu.
paralokaraajyamu, thama diviteelu pattukoni pendli kumaaruni edurkonutaku bayaludherina padhimandi kanyakalanu poliyunnadhi.
veerilo ayiduguru buddhileni vaaru, ayiduguru buddhigalavaaru.
buddhi lenivaaru thama diviteelu pattukoni thamathookooda noone theesikonipoledu.
buddhigalavaaru thama diviteelathookooda siddelalo noone theesi konipoyiri.
pendlikumaarudu aalasyamu cheyagaa vaarandaru kuniki nidrinchu chundiri.
ardharaatrivela idigo pendlikumaarudu, athanini edurkona randi anu keka vinabadenu.
appudu aa kanyakalandaru lechi thama diviteelanu chakkaparachiri gaani
buddhileni aa kanyakalu maa diviteelu aaripovuchunnavi ganuka mee noonelo konchemu maakiyyudani buddhigalavaarinadigiri.
anduku buddhigala kanyakalumaakunu meekunu idi chaaladhemo, meeru ammuvaariyoddhaku poyi konukkonudani cheppiri.
vaaru konabovuchundagaa pendlikumaarudu vacchenu, appudu siddhapadi yunnavaaru athanithoo kooda pendli vinduku lopaliki poyiri;
anthata thalupu veyabadenu. aa tharu vaatha thakkina kanyakalu vachi'ayyaa, ayyaa, maaku thalupu theeyumani adugagaa
athadumimmu neruganani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
aa dinamainanu gadiyayainanu meeku teliyadu ganuka melakuvagaa undudi.
(paralokaraajyamu) oka manushyudu dheshaantharamunaku prayaanamai thana daasulanu pilichi thana aasthini vaari kappa ginchinatlundunu.
athadu okaniki ayidu thalaanthulanu okaniki rendu, okaniki okatiyu evani saamarthyamu choppuna vaanikichi, ventane dheshaantharamu poyenu.
ayidu thalaanthulu theesikoninavaadu velli vaatithoo vyaapaaramu chesi, mari ayidu thalaanthulu sampaa dinchenu.
aalaagunane rendu theesikoninavaadu mari rendu sampaadhinchenu.
ayithe oka thalaanthu theesikoninavaadu velli, bhoomi travvi thana yajamaanuni sommu daachipettenu.
bahu kaalamaina tharuvaatha aa daasula yajamaanudu vachi vaariyoddha lekka choochukonenu.
appudu ayidu thalaanthulu theesikoninavaadu mari ayidu thalaanthulu techi ayyaa, neevu naaku ayidu thalaanthulappaginchi thive; aviyugaaka mari yayidu thalaanthulu sampaadhinchithinani cheppenu.

athani yajamaanudu bhalaa, nammakamaina manchi daasudaa, neevu ee konchemulo nammakamugaa untivi, ninnu anekamainavaatimeeda niyaminchedanu, nee yajamaanuni santhooshamulo paalupondumani athanithoo cheppenu.
aalaage rendu thalaanthulu theesikoninavaadu vachi'ayyaa, neevu naaku rendu thalaanthulappaginchithive aviyu gaaka mari rendu thalaanthulu sampaadhinchithinani cheppenu.

athani yajamaanudubhalaa, nammakamaina manchi daasudaa, neevu ee konchemulo nammakamugaa untivi, ninnu anekamainavaatimeeda niyaminchedanu, nee yajamaa nuni santhooshamulo paalu pondumani athanithoo cheppenu.
tharuvaatha oka thalaanthu theesikoninavaadunu vachi ayyaa, neevu vitthanichoota koyuvaadavunu, challani choota panta koorchukonuvaadavunaina kathinudavani nenerugu dunu
ganuka nenu bhayapadi, velli nee thalaanthunu bhoomilo daachipettithini; idigo needi neevu theesikonumani cheppenu.
anduku athani yajamaanudu vaanini chuchi somarivaina cheddadaasudaa, nenu vitthanichoota koyuvaadanu, challani choota panta koorchukonuvaadanani neevu eruguduvaa?
atlayithe neevu naa sommu saahukaarulayoddha uncha valasi yundenu; nenu vachi vaddithookooda naa sommu theesikoniyundune ani cheppi
aa thalaanthunu vaani yoddhanundi theesivesi, padhi thalaanthulu galavaani kiyyudi.
kaligina prathivaaniki iyyabadunu athaniki samruddhi kalugunu; lenivaaniyoddhanundi vaaniki kaliginadhiyu theesi veyabadunu.
mariyu panikimaalina aa daasuni velupati chikatiloniki trosiveyudi; akkada edpunu pandlu korukutayu undunanenu.
thana mahimathoo manushyakumaarudunu aayanathoo kooda samastha doothalunu vachunappudu aayana thana mahimagala sinhaasanamumeeda aaseenudai yundunu.
appudu samastha janamulu aayanayeduta pogu cheyabaduduru; gollavaadu mekalalonundi gorrelanu veruparachunatlu aayana vaarini veruparachi
thana kudivaipuna gorrelanu edamavaipuna meka lanu niluvabettunu.

appudu raaju thana kudivaipuna unnavaarini chuchi naa thandrichetha aasheervadhimpabadinavaara laaraa, randi; lokamu puttinadhi modalukoni meekoraku siddhaparachabadina raajyamunu svathantrinchukonudi.
nenu aakaligontini, meeru naaku bhojanamu pettithiri; dappi gontini, naaku daahamichithiri, paradheshinai yuntini nannu cherchukontiri;
digambarinai yuntini, naaku batta lichithiri; roginaiyuntini, nannu choodavachithiri; chera saalalo untini naayoddhaku vachithirani cheppunu
anduku neethimanthuluprabhuvaa, yeppudu neevu aakaligoniyunduta chuchi neekaahaaramichi thivi? neevu dappigoni yunduta chuchi yeppudu daahamichithivi?
eppudu paradheshivai yunduta chuchi ninnu cherchukontimi? Digambarivai yunduta chuchi battalichithivi?
eppudu rogivai yundutayainanu, cherasaalalo undutayainanu, chuchi, neeyoddhaku vachithimani aayananu adigedaru.
anduku raajumikkili alpulaina yee naa sahodarulalo okaniki meeru chesithiri ganuka naaku chesithirani nishcha yamugaa meethoo cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo anunu.
appudaayana yedamavaipuna unduvaarini chuchishapimpabadinavaaralaaraa, nannu vidichi apavaadhikini vaani doothala kunu siddhaparachabadina nityaagniloniki povudi.
nenu aakaligontini, meeru naaku bhojanamu pettaledu; dappi gontini, meeru naaku daahamiyyaledu;
paradheshinai yuntini, meeru nannu cherchukonaledu; digambarinai yuntini, meeru naaku battaliyyaledu; roginai cherasaalalo untini, meeru nannu chooda raaledani cheppunu.

anduku vaarunu prabhuvaa, memeppudu neevu aakaligoni yundutayainanu, dappigoniyundutayainanu, paradheshivai yundutayainanu, digambarivai yundutayainanu, rogivai yunduta, cherasaalalo undutayainanu choochi, neeku upakaaramu cheyakapothimani ayananu adigedaru.
andukaayana mikkili alpulaina veerilo okanikainanu meeru eelaagu cheyaledu ganuka naaku cheyaledani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaanani vaarithoo anunu.
veeru nityashikshakunu neethimanthulu nityajeevamunakunu povuduru.
yesu ee maatalanniyu cheppi chaalinchina tharuvaatha jariginadhemanagaa aayana thana shishyulanu chuchi
rendu dinamulaina pimmata paskaapanduga vachunaniyu, appudu manushyakumaarudu siluvaveyabadutakai appagimpabadunaniyu meeku teliyunani cheppenu.
aa samayamuna pradhaanayaajakulunu prajala peddalunu kayapa anu pradhaanayaajakuni mandiramuloniki koodivachi
yesunu maayopaayamuchetha pattukoni, champavalenani yekamai aalochana chesiri.
ayithe prajalalo allari kalugakundu natlupandugalo vaddani cheppukoniri.
yesu bethaniyalo kushtharogiyaina seemonu inta nunnappudu,
oka stree mikkili viluvagala attharubuddi theesikoni aayanayoddhaku vachi, aayana bhojanamunaku koorchundagaa daanini aayana thalameeda posenu.
shishyulu chuchi kopapadi ee nashtamenduku?
deenini goppa velaku ammi beedala kiyyavachune aniri.
yesu aa sangathi telisi koni'ee stree naa vishayamai yoka manchi kaaryamu chesenu; eemenu meerela tondharapettuchunnaaru?
beedalellappudu meethookooda unnaaru. Gaani nenellappudu meethoo kooda undanu.
eeme yee attharu naa shareeramu meeda posi naa bhoosthaapana nimitthamu deenini chesenu.
sarvalokamandu ee suvaartha ekkada prakatimpabaduno, akkada eeme chesinadhiyu eeme gnaapakaarthamugaa prashansimpabadunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaa nani vaarithoo anenu.
appudu pandrendumandilo nokadagu iskariyothu yoodhaa, pradhaanayaajakulayoddhaku velli
nenaayananu meekappaginchinayedala naakemi itthurani vaarinadigenu. Anduku vaaru muppadhi vendi naanamulu thoochi vaaniki ichiri.
vaadappatinundi aayananu appaginchutaku thagina samayamu kanipettu chundenu.
puliyani rottela pandugalo modati dinamandu, shishyulu yesunoddhaku vachipaskaanu bhujinchutaku memu neekoraku ekkada siddhaparacha goruchunnaavani adi giri.

andukaayana meeru pattanamandunna phalaani manushyuniyoddhaku vellinaa kaalamu sameepamaiyunnadhi; naa shishyulathoo kooda nee yinta paskaanu aacharinchedhanani bodhakudu cheppuchunnaadani athanithoo cheppudanenu
yesu thama kaagnaapinchina prakaaramu shishyulu chesi paskaanu siddhaparachiri.
saayankaalamainappudu aayana pandrendumandi shishyulathookooda bhojanamunaku koorchuṁ denu.
vaaru bhojanamu cheyuchundagaa aayana meelo okadu nannu appaginchunani meethoo nishchayamugaa cheppu chunnaananenu.
anduku vaaru bahu duḥkhapadi prathi vaadunuprabhuvaa, nenaa? Ani aayana nadugagaa
aayananaathookooda paatralo cheyyi munchina vaadevado vaade nannu appaginchuvaadu.

manushyakumaa runigoorchi vraayabadina prakaaramu aayana povuchunnaadu gaani yevanichetha manushyakumaarudu appa gimpabaduchunnaado aa manushyuniki shrama; aa manushyudu puttiyundaniyedala vaaniki melani cheppenu.
aayananu appaginchina yoodhaabodhakudaa, nenaa? Ani adugagaa aayananeevannatte anenu.
vaaru bhojanamu cheyuchundagaa yesu oka rotte pattukoni, daani naasheervadhinchi, virichi thana shishyulakichi meeru theesikoni thinudi; idi naa shareeramani cheppenu.
mariyu aayana ginne pattukoni kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchi vaarikichi deenilonidi meerandaru traagudi.
idi naa rakthamu, anagaa paapakshamaapana nimitthamu anekula koraku chindimpabaduchunna nibandhana rakthamu.
naa thandri raajyamulo meethookooda nenu ee draakshaarasamu krottha digaa traagu dinamuvaraku, ikanu daani traaganani meethoo cheppuchunnaananenu.
anthata vaaru keerthana paadi oleevala kondaku velliri.
appudu yesu vaarini chuchi ee raatri meerandaru naa vishayamai abhyantharapadedaru, yelayanagaa gorrela kaaparini kottudunu, mandaloni gorrelu chedaripovunu ani vraayabadi yunnadhi gadaa.
nenu lechina tharuvaatha meekante mundhugaa galilayaku velleda nanenu.
anduku pethurunee vishayamai andaru abhyanthara padinanu nenu eppudunu abhyantharapadanani aayanathoo cheppagaa
yesu athani chuchi'ee raatri kodi kooyaka munupe neevu nannu eruganani mummaaru cheppedavani neethoo nishchayamugaa cheppuchunnaananenu.
pethuraayananu chuchinenu neethookooda chaavavalasivachinanu, ninnu eruga nani cheppananenu; adheprakaaramu shishyulandaru aniri.
anthata yesu vaarithookooda getsemane anabadina chootiki vachinenu akkadiki velli praarthanachesi vachu varaku meerikkada koorchundudani shishyulathoo cheppi
pethurunu jebedayi yiddaru kumaarulanu ventabettukoni poyi, duḥkhapadutakunu chinthaakraanthudagutakunu modalu pettenu.
appudu yesu maranamagunanthagaa naa praanamu bahu duḥkhamulo munigiyunnadhi;meeru ikkada nilichi, naathookooda melakuvagaa nundudani vaarithoo cheppi
kontha dooramu velli, saagilapadi naa thandree, saadhyamaithe ee ginne naayoddhanundi tolagi ponimmu, ayinanu naa yishtaprakaaramu kaadu nee chitthaprakaarame kaanimmani praarthinchenu.
aayana marala shishyulayoddhaku vachi, vaaru nidrinchuta chuchi'oka gadiyayainanu naathookooda melkoniyundaleraa?
meeru shodhanalo praveshinchakundunatlu melakuvagaa undi praarthanacheyudi; aatma siddhame gaani shareeramu balaheena mani pethuruthoo cheppi
marala rendavamaaru vellinaa thandree, nenu deenini traagithene gaani yidi naayoddhanundi tolagi povuta saadhyamukaaniyedala, nee chitthame siddhinchu gaaka ani praarthinchi
thirigi vachi, vaaru marala nidrinchuta chuchenu; yelayanagaa vaari kannulu bhaaramugaa undenu.
aayana vaarini marala vidichi velli, aa maatale cheppuchu moodava maaru praarthanachesenu.
appudaayana thana shishyulayoddhaku vachi'ika nidrapoyi alasata theerchu konudi; idigo aa gadiyavachi yunnadhi; manushyakumaarudu paapulachethiki appagimpabaduchunnaadu;
lendi velludamu; idigo nannu appaginchuvaadu sameepinchi yunnaadani vaarithoo cheppenu.

aayana inkanu maatalaaduchundagaa pandrendu mandilo okadagu yoodhaa vacchenu. Vaanithookooda bahu janasamoohamu katthulu gudiyalu pattukoni pradhaana yaajakulayoddhanundiyu prajala peddalayoddha nundiyu vacchenu.
aayananu appaginchuvaadu neneva rini muddupettukonduno aayane yesu; aayananu pattukonudani vaariki guruthu cheppi
ventane yesu noddhaku vachibodhakudaa, neeku shubhamani cheppi aayananu muddu pettukonenu.
yesu chelikaadaa, neevu cheyavachi nadhi cheyumani athanithoo cheppagaa vaaru daggaraku vachi aayanameedapadi aayananu pattukoniri.
idigo yesuthoo kooda unnavaarilo okadu cheyyi chaachi, katthi doosi pradhaanayaajakuni daasuni kotti, vaani chevi teganarikenu.
yesu nee katthi varalo thirigi pettumu; katthi pattukonu vaarandaru katthichethane nashinthuru.
ee samayamuna nenu naa thandrini vedukonalenaniyu, vedukoninayedala aayana pandrendu senaa vyoohamulakante ekkuva mandi doothalanu ippude naaku pampadaniyu neevanukonu chunnaavaa?
nenu vedukonina yedala eelaagu jaruga valenanu lekhanamu elaagu neraverunani athanithoo cheppenu.

aa gadiyalone yesu janasamoohamulanu chuchibandipotu dongameediki vachinattu katthulathoonu gudiyalathoonu nannu pattukonavachithiraa? Nenu anudinamu dhevaalayamulo koorchundi bodhinchuchunnappudu meeru nannu pattukonaledu.
ayithe pravakthala lekhanamulu neraverunatlu idanthayu jarigenani cheppenu. Appudu shishyulandaru aayananu vidichi paaripoyiri.
yesunu pattukoninavaaru pradhaanayaajakudaina kayapa yoddhaku aayananu theesikonipogaa, akkada shaastrulunu peddalunu koodiyundiri.
pethuru pradhaanayaajakuni yinti mungitivaraku, aayananu dooramunundi vembadinchi lopaliki poyideeni antha memavuno choodavalenani bantrauthulathookooda koorchundenu.
pradhaanayaajakulunu, mahaa sabhavaarandarunu, yesunu champavalenani aayanaku virodhamugaa abaddhasaakshyamu vedakuchundiri kaani
abaddhasaakshulanekulu vachinanu saakshyamemiyu dorakaledu.
thudaku iddaru manushyulu vachiveedu dhevaalayamunu padagotti, moodu dinamulalo daanini katta galanani cheppenaniri.
pradhaanayaajakudu lechineevu utthara memiyu cheppavaa? Veeru neemeeda palukuchunna saakshyamemani adugagaa yesu oorakundenu.
anduku pradhaana yaajakudu aayananu chuchineevu dhevuni kumaarudavaina kreesthuvaithe aa maata maathoo cheppumani jeevamugala dhevuni thoodani neeku aanabettuchunnaananenu. Anduku yesu– neevannatte.
idi modalukoni manushyakumaarudu sarva shakthuni kudipaarshvamuna koorchundutayu, aakaasha meghaa roodhudai vachutayu meeru choothurani cheppagaa
pradhaanayaajakudu thana vastramu chimpukoni--veedu dheva dooshana chesenu; manakika saakshulathoo pani emi? Idigo ee dooshana meerippudu vinnaaru;
meekemi thoochuchunnadani adigenu. Anduku vaaruveedu maranamunaku paatrudaniri.
appudu vaaru aayana mukhamumeeda ummivesi, aayananu guddiri;
kondaru aayananu ara chethulathoo kottikreesthoo,ninnu kottinavaadevado pravachimpu maniri.
pethuru velupati mungita koorchundiyundagaa oka chinnadhi athaniyoddhaku vachineevunu galilayudagu yesuthoo kooda untivi gadaa anenu.
andukathadu nenundaledu; neevu cheppusangathi naaku teliyadani andari yeduta anenu.
athadu nadavaloniki vellina tharuvaatha mari yoka chinnadhi athanini chuchiveedunu najareyudagu yesuthookooda undenani akkadi vaarithoo cheppagaa
athadu ottupettukoni nenundaledu; aa manushyuni neneruganani marala cheppenu.
konthasepaina tharuvaatha akkada nilichiyunnavaaru pethurunoddhaku vachi nijame, neevunu vaarilo okadave; nee paluku ninnugoorchi saakshya michuchunnadani athanithoo cheppiri.
anduku athadu aa manushyuni neneruganani cheppi shapinchukonutakunu ottupettukonutakunu modalu pettenu. Ventane kodi koosenu
kanukakodi kooyaka munupu neevu nanneruganani mummaaru cheppedavani yesu thanathoo anina maata pethuru gnaapakamu techukoni velupaliki poyi santhaapa padi yedchenu.
udayamainappudu pradhaanayaajakulunu,prajala peddalandarunu yesunu champimpavalenani aayanaku virodhamugaa aalochanachesi
aayananu bandhinchi, theesikonipoyi, adhipathiyaina ponthipilaathunaku appaginchiri.
appudaayananu appaginchina yoodhaa, aayanaku shiksha vidhimpabadagaa chuchi pashchaatthaapapadi, aa muppadhi vendi naanamulu pradhaanayaajakulayoddhakunu peddalayoddhakunu marala techi
nenu niraparaadharakthamunu appaginchi paapamu chesithinani cheppenu. Vaarudaanithoo maakemi? neeve choochukonumani cheppagaa
athadu aa vendi naana mulu dhevaalayamulo paaravesi, poyi uripettu konenu.
pradhaanayaajakulu aa vendi naanamulu theesikoni ivi rakthakrayadhanamu ganuka veetini kaanuka pettelo veyathagadani cheppukoniri.
kaabatti vaaru aalochanachesi vaatinichi, paradheshulanu paathipettutaku kummari vaani polamu koniri.
anduvalana netivaraku aa polamu rakthapu polamanabaduchunnadhi.
appuduviluva kattabadinavaani, anagaa ishraayeleeyulalo kondaru viluvakattinavaani krayadhanamaina muppadhi
vendi naanamulu theesikoni prabhuvu naaku niya minchinaprakaaramu vaatini kummari vaani polamuna kichiri ani pravakthayaina yirmeeyaadvaaraa cheppabadinamaata neraverenu.
yesu adhipathiyeduta nilichenu; appudu adhipathiyoodula raajavu neevenaa? Ani aayana nadugagaa yesu athani chuchineevannatte anenu
pradhaanayaajakulunu peddalunu aayanameeda neramu mopinappudu aayana pratyuttharamemiyu iyyaledu.
kaabatti pilaathu neemeeda veerenni neramulu mopuchunnaaro neevu vinaledaa? Ani aayananu adigenu.
ayithe aayana oka maatakainanu athaniki uttharamiyyaledu ganuka adhipathi mikkili aashcharyapadenu.
janulu korukonina yoka khayideeni pandugalo vidudala cheyuta adhipathiki vaaduka.
aa kaalamandu barabba anu prasiddhudaina yoka khayidee cherasaalalo undenu.
kaabatti janulu koodi vachinappudu pilaathu nenevanini
vidudalacheyavalenani meeru koruchunnaaru? Barabbanaa leka kreesthanabadina yesunaa? Ani vaarini adigenu. yelayanagaa vaaru asooyachetha aayananu appaginchirani athadu erigi yundenu

athadu nyaayapeethamumeeda koorchundiyunnappudu athani bhaarya - neevu aa neethimanthuni joliki povaddu; ee proddu aaya nanugoorchi nenu kalalo mikkili baadhapadithinani athani yoddhaku varthamaanamu pampenu
pradhaanayaajakulunu peddalunu, barabbanu vidipinchumani adugutakunu, yesunu sanharinchutakunu janasamoohamulanu prerepinchiri
adhipathi ee yiddarilo nenevanini vidudala cheyavalenani meeru koruchunnaarani vaarinadugagaa vaaru barabbane aniri.
anduku pilaathu aalaagaithe kreesthanabadina yesunu emi chethunani vaarinadugagaa siluvaveyumani andarunu cheppiri.
adhipathi enduku? Ithadu e dushkaa ryamu chesenani adugagaa vaarusiluvaveyumani mari ekkuvagaa kekaluvesiri.

pilaathu allari ekkuvagu chunnadhe gaani thanavalana prayojanamemiyu ledani grahinchi, neellu theesikoni janasamoohamu eduta chethulu kadugukoni'ee neethimanthuni rakthamunugoorchi nenu niraparaadhini, meere choochukonudani cheppenu.
anduku praja landaruvaani rakthamu maa meedanu maa pillalameedanu undugaakaniri.
appudathadu vaaru korinattu barabbanu vaariki vidudala chesi, yesunu koradaalathoo kottinchi siluvaveya nappaginchenu.
appudu adhipathiyokka sainikulu yesunu adhikaara mandiramuloniki theesikonipoyi, aayanayoddha sainikula nandarini samakoorchiri.
vaaru aayana vastramulu theesi vesi, aayanaku errani angee todiginchi
mundla kireetamunu alli aayana thalaku petti, oka rellu aayana kudi chethilonunchi, aayanayeduta mokaallooni yoodula raajaa, neeku shubhamani aayananu apahasinchi
aayana meeda ummivesi, aa rellunu theesikoni daanithoo aayananu thalameeda kottiri.
aayananu apahasinchina tharuvaatha aayana meedanunna aa angeeni theesivesi aayana vastramu laayanaku todiginchi,siluva veyutaku aayananu theesikoni poyiri.
vaaru velluchundagaa kureneeyudaina seemonanu okadu kanabadagaa aayana siluvamoyutaku athanini balavanthamu chesiri.
vaaru kapaalasthalamanu arthamichu golgothaa ana badina chootiki vachi
chedu kalipina draakshaarasamunu aayanaku traaganichiri gaani aayana daanini ruchi chuchi traaganollakapoyenu.
vaaru aayananu siluvavesina pimmata chitluvesi aayana vastramulu panchukoniri.
anthata vaarakkada koorchundi aayanaku kaavali yundiri.
ithadu yoodula raajaina yesu ani aayanameeda mopabadina neramu vraasi aayana thalaku paigaa unchiri.
mariyu kudivaipuna okadunu edama vaipuna okadunu iddaru bandipotu dongalu aayanathoo kooda siluvaveya badiri.
aa maargamuna velluchundinavaaru thalaloochuchu
dhevaalayamunu padagotti moodu dinamulalo kattuvaadaa, ninnu neeve rakshinchukonumu; neevu dhevuni kumaarudavaithe siluvameedanundi digumani cheppuchu aayananu dooshinchiri
aalaage shaastrulunu peddalunu pradhaanayaajakulunu kooda aayananu apahasinchuchu
veedu itharulanu rakshinchenu, thannu thaane rakshinchukonaledu; ishraayelu raajugadaa, yippudu siluvameedanundi diginayedala vaani nammudumu.
vaadu dhevuniyandu vishvaasamunchenu, nenu dhevuni kumaarudanani cheppenu ganuka aayanakishtudaithe aayana ippudu vaanini thappinchunani cheppiri.
aayanathoo kooda siluvaveyabadina bandipotu dongalunu aalaage aayananu nindinchiri.
madhyaahnamu modalukoni moodu gantalavaraku aa dheshamanthatanu chikatikammenu.
inchuminchu moodu gantalappudu yesu elee, elee, laamaa sabakthaanee ani biggaragaa kekavesenu. aa maataku naa dhevaa, naa dhevaa nannenduku cheyyi vidichithivani arthamu.
akkada nilichiyunnavaarilo kondharaa maata vini ithadu eleeyaanu piluchuchunnaadaniri.
ventane vaarilo okadu parugetthikoni poyi, spanjee theesikoni chirakaalo munchi, relluna thagilinchi aayanaku traaganicchenu;
thakkinavaaru oorakundudi eleeyaa athani rakshimpavachunemo chootha maniri.
yesu marala biggaragaa kekavesi praanamu vidichenu.
appudu dhevaalayapu tera painundi krindi varaku rendugaa chinigenu; bhoomi vanakenu; bandalu baddalaayenu;
samaadhulu teravabadenu; nidrinchina aneka mandi parishuddhula shareeramulu lechenu.
vaaru samaadhulalonundi bayatiki vachi aayana lechinatharuvaatha parishuddha pattanamulo praveshinchi anekulaku agapadiri.
shathaadhipathiyu athanithoo kooda yesunaku kaavali yunnavaarunu, bhookampamunu jarigina kaaryamulannitini chuchi, mikkili bhayapadinijamugaa eeyana dhevuni kumaarudani cheppu koniri.
yesunaku upachaaramu cheyuchu galilaya nundi aayananu vembadinchina anekamandi streelu akkada dooramunundi choochuchundiri.
vaarilo magdalene mariyayu yaakobu yose anuvaari thalliyaina mariyayu, jebedayi kumaarula thalliyu undiri.
yesu shishyudugaanunna arimathayiya yosepu anu oka dhanavanthudu saayankaalamainappudu vachi
pilaathu noddhaku velli, yesu dhehamunu thanakimmani adugagaa, pilaathu daanini athani kappagimpa naagnaapinchenu.
yosepu aa dhehamunu theesikoni shubhramaina naarabattathoo chutti
thaanu raathilo tolipinchukonina krottha samaadhilo daanini unchi, samaadhi dvaaramunaku peddharaayi porlinchi vellipoyenu.
magdalene mariyayu, veroka mari yayu, akkadane samaadhiki edurugaa koorchundiyundiri.
marunaadu anagaa siddhaparachu dinamunaku marusati dinamuna pradhaanayaajakulunu parisayyulunu pilaathu noddhaku koodivachi
ayyaa, aa vanchakudu sajeevudai yundinappudu moodu dinamulaina tharuvaatha nenu lechedhanani cheppinadhi maaku gnaapakamunnadhi.

kaabatti moodava dinamuvaraku samaadhini bhadramu cheya naagnaapinchumu; vaani shishyulu vachi vaanini etthukonipoyi aayana mruthulalonundi lechenani prajalathoo cheppuduremo; appudu modati vanchanakante kadapati vanchana mari cheddadai yundunani cheppiri.
anduku pilaathu kaavalivaarunnaarugadaa meeru velli mee chethanainantha mattuku samaadhini bhadramu cheyudani vaarithoo cheppenu.
vaaru velli kaavalivaarini kooda unchukoni, raathiki mudravesi samaadhini bhadramuchesiri.
vishraanthidinamu gadachipoyina tharuvaatha aadhivaaramuna, tellavaaruchundagaa magdalene mariyayu veroka mariyayu samaadhini choodavachiri.
idigo prabhuvu dootha paralokamunundi digivachi, raayi porlinchi daani meeda koorchundenu; appudu mahaabhookampamu kaligenu.
aa dootha svaroopamu merupuvale nundenu, athani vastramu himamantha tellagaa undenu.
athaniki bhaya padutavalana kaavalivaaru vanaki chachinavaarivale nundiri.
dootha aa streelanu chuchimeeru bhayapadakudi, siluva veyabadina yesunu meeru vedakuchunnaarani naaku teliyunu;
aayana ikkada ledu; thaanu cheppinatte aayana lechi yunnaadu; randi prabhuvu pandukonina sthalamu chuchi

tvaragaa velli, aayana mruthulalonundi lechiyunnaadani aayana shishyulaku teliyajeyudi; idigo aayana galilayaloniki meeku mundhugaa vellu chunnaadu, akkada meeru aayananu choothuru; idigo meethoo cheppithinanenu.
vaaru bhayamuthoonu mahaa aanandamuthoonu samaadhiyoddhanundi tvaragaa velli aayana shishyulaku aa varthamaanamu telupa parugetthuchundagaa
yesu vaarini edurkoni meeku shubhamani cheppenu.Vaaru aayana yoddhaku vachi, aayana paadamulu pattukoni aayanaku mrokkagaa
yesu bhayapadakudi; meeru velli, naa sahodarulu galilayaku vellavalenaniyu vaarakkada nannu choothuraniyu vaariki telupudanenu.
vaaru velluchundagaa kaavalivaarilo kondaru pattanamu loniki vachi jarigina sangathulannitini pradhaana yaajakulathoo cheppiri.
kaabatti vaaru peddalathoo koodi vachi aalochanachesi aa sainikulaku chaala dravyamichi
memu nidrapovuchundagaa athani shishyulu raatri velavachi athanini etthikonipoyirani meeru cheppudi;
idi adhipathi chevini badinayedala memathani sammathiparachi meekemiyu tondharakalugakunda chethumani cheppiri.
appudu vaaru aa dravyamu theesikoni thamaku bodhimpabadinaprakaaramu chesiri. ee maata yoodulalo vyaapinchi netivaraku prasiddhamaiyunnadhi.
padunokandumandi shishyulu yesu thamaku nirnayinchina galilayaloni kondaku velliri.
vaaru aayananu chuchi aayanaku mrokkirigaani, kondaru sandhehinchiri.
ayithe yesu vaariyoddhaku vachi paralokamandunu bhoomimeedanu naaku sarvaadhi kaaramu iyyabadiyunnadhi.
kaabatti meeru velli, samastha janulanu shishyulanugaacheyudi; thandriyokkayu kumaaruniyokkayu parishuddhaatmayokkayu naamamuloniki vaariki baapthisma michuchu
nenu meeku e ye sangathulanu aagnaapinchi thino vaatinannitini gaikona valenani vaariki bodhinchudi.Idigo nenu yugasamaapthi varaku sadaakaalamu meethoo kooda unnaanani vaarithoo cheppenu.
